<h1 id="beezup-merchant-api-">BeezUP Merchant API  v2.0</h1>

> Scroll down for code samples, example requests and responses. Select a language for code samples from the tabs above or the mobile navigation menu.

# The REST API of BeezUP system
## Overview
The REST APIs provide programmatic access to read and write BeezUP data. 
Basically, with this API you will be able to do everything like you were with your browser on https://go.beezup.com !

The main features are:
- Register and manage your account
- Create and manage and share your stores with your friends/co-workers.
- Import your product catalog and schedule the auto importation
- Search the channels your want to use
- Configure your channels for your catalogs to export your product information:
    - cost and general settings
    - category and columns mappings
    - your will be able to create and manage your custom column
    - put in place exlusion filters based on simple conditions on your product data
    - override product values
    - get product vision for a channel catalog scope
- Analyze and optimize your performance of your catalogs on all yours channels with different type of reportings by day, channel, category and by product.
- Automatize your optimisation by using rules!
- And of course... Manage your orders harvested from all your marketplaces:
    - Synchronize your orders in an uniformized way
    - Get the available actions and update the order status
- ...and more!

## Authentication credentials
The public API with the base path **/v2/public** have been put in place to give you an entry point to our system for the user registration, login and lost password. The public API does not require any credentials.
We give you the some public list of values and public channels for our public commercial web site [www.beezup.com](http://www.beezup.com).

The user API with the base path **/v2/user** requires a token which is available on this page:
https://go.beezup.com/Account/MyAccount

## Things to keep in mind
### API Rate Limits
- The BeezUP REST API is limited to 100 calls/minute.

### Media type
The default media type for requests and responses is application/json. Where noted, some operations support other content types. If no additional content type is mentioned for a specific operation, then the media type is application/json.

### Required content type
The required and default encoding for the request and responses is UTF8.

### Required date time format
All our date time are formatted in ISO 8601 format: 2014-06-24T16:25:00Z.

### Base URL
The Base URL of the BeezUP API Order Management REST API conforms to the following template.

https://api.beezup.com

All URLs returned by the BeezUP API are relative to this base URL, and all requests to the REST API must use this base URL template.

You can test our API on https://api-docs.beezup.com/swagger-ui\\
You can contact us on [gitter, #BeezUP/API](https://gitter.im/BeezUP/API)

Base URLs:

* <a href="https://api.beezup.com">https://api.beezup.com</a>

Email: <a href="mailto:help@beezup.com">help@beezup.com</a> 
License: <a href="https://www.beezup.com/">BeezUP</a>

<a href="https://api-docs.beezup.com/">Find the documentation for BeezUP's API here</a>

# Authentication

* API Key (api_key)
    - Parameter Name: **Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key**, in: header.

<h1 id="beezup-merchant-api--public---security---security">Public - Security - Security</h1>

## Login

<a id="opIdLogin"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/public/security/login \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "login": "paulsimon@mysupercompany.com",
    "password": "I@mW0nder$Full"
  }'
```

`POST /v2/public/security/login`

User Login - The login will give your tokens

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "login": "paulsimon@mysupercompany.com",
  "password": "I@mW0nder$Full"
}
```

<h3 id="login-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[loginRequest](#schemaloginrequest)|true|none|
|» login|body|[BeezUP.Common.Email](#schemabeezup.common.email)|true|The email|
|» password|body|string(password)|true|Your password|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "credentials": [
    {
      "primaryToken": "3b22980d8d1143c6ba7adf4e55b9a153",
      "productName": "UserApi",
      "secondaryToken": "162ae17fd52044c38cce3388ea5b0c91"
    }
  ]
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "arguments": [
        {
          "name": "currentCatalogImportationId",
          "value": {}
        }
      ],
      "code": "CatalogImportationAlreadyInProgress(ExecutionId currentCatalogImportationId)",
      "cultureName": "en",
      "docUrl": "https://api-docs.beezup.com/#operation/EnableChannelCatalog",
      "message": "There is already an importation in progress: b24d0dd8-a561-478a-9b26-34f573f03527\n"
    }
  ]
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "arguments": [
        {
          "name": "currentCatalogImportationId",
          "value": {}
        }
      ],
      "code": "CatalogImportationAlreadyInProgress(ExecutionId currentCatalogImportationId)",
      "cultureName": "en",
      "docUrl": "https://api-docs.beezup.com/#operation/EnableChannelCatalog",
```

<h3 id="login-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Your tokens|[apiCredentials](#schemaapicredentials)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|[BeezUP.Common.ErrorResponseMessage](#schemabeezup.common.errorresponsemessage)|
|403|Forbidden|Invalid credentials|None|
|500|Internal Server Error|Occurs when something goes wrong|[BeezUP.Common.ErrorResponseMessage](#schemabeezup.common.errorresponsemessage)|

## User Registration

<a id="opIdRegister"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/public/security/register \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "commercialOwnerUserId": "47ea14ab-195d-4f9a-a24e-32c329ee40f6",
    "cultureName": "en-GB",
    "email": "myemail@mycompany.com",
    "password": "I@mW0nder$Full"
  }'
```

`POST /v2/public/security/register`

User Registration - Create a new user on BeezUP

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "commercialOwnerUserId": "47ea14ab-195d-4f9a-a24e-32c329ee40f6",
  "cultureName": "en-GB",
  "email": "myemail@mycompany.com",
  "password": "I@mW0nder$Full"
}
```

<h3 id="user-registration-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[registerRequest](#schemaregisterrequest)|true|none|
|» commercialOwnerUserId|body|string(uuid)|false|The user id of your commercial in BeezUP.|
|» cultureName|body|string|false|Can be null. Default: en-GB. The culture name you want to use. FYI. \<br>The email activation will use this culture.<br>|
|» email|body|string|true|Your email. We refuse disposable email.|
|» password|body|string|true|The password you want to use for your new account. \<br>The password length must be greater or equals to 6 and lower or equals to 128. \<br>The password must contains at least one number and one special character<br>|

> Example responses

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "arguments": [
        {
          "name": "currentCatalogImportationId",
          "value": {}
        }
      ],
      "code": "CatalogImportationAlreadyInProgress(ExecutionId currentCatalogImportationId)",
      "cultureName": "en",
      "docUrl": "https://api-docs.beezup.com/#operation/EnableChannelCatalog",
      "message": "There is already an importation in progress: b24d0dd8-a561-478a-9b26-34f573f03527\n"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="user-registration-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Customer registered|None|
|400|Bad Request|Email or password is invalid. Disposable email are refused.|None|
|409|Conflict|Email already used|None|
|500|Internal Server Error|Occurs when something goes wrong|[BeezUP.Common.ErrorResponseMessage](#schemabeezup.common.errorresponsemessage)|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Get public channel index

<a id="opIdGetChannelsIndex"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/public/channels/ \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /v2/public/channels/`

Use this operation to get the correct link to the channels and to the list of values

<h3 id="get-public-channel-index-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|If-None-Match|header|string|false|ETag value to identify the last known version of requested resource.\<br>To avoid useless exchange, we recommend you to indicate the ETag you previously got from this operation.\<br>If the ETag value does not match the response will be 200 to give you a new content, otherwise the response will be: 304 Not Modified, without any content.\<br>For more details go to this link: http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7232#section-2.3<br>|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "channels": {
    "DEU": {
      "href": "/v2/public/channels/DEU",
      "method": "GET"
    },
    "ESP": {
      "href": "/v2/public/channels/ESP'",
      "method": "GET"
    },
    "FRA": {
      "href": "/v2/public/channels/FRA",
      "method": "GET"
    },
    "GBR": {
      "href": "/v2/public/channels/GBR",
      "method": "GET"
    },
    "ITA": {
      "href": "/v2/public/channels/ITA",
      "method": "GET"
    }
  },
  "links": {
    "channelCountryLov": {
      "href": "/v2/public/lov/www_ChannelCountry",
      "method": "GET"
    },
    "channelTypeLov": {
      "href": "/v2/public/lov/ChannelType",
      "method": "GET"
    },
    "sectorLov": {
      "href": "/v2/public/lov/ParamSector",
      "method": "GET"
    },
    "self": {
      "href": "/v2/public/channels",
      "method": "GET"
    }
  }
}
```

> default Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "arguments": [
        {
          "name": "currentCatalogImportationId",
          "value": {}
        }
      ],
      "code": "CatalogImportationAlreadyInProgress(ExecutionId currentCatalogImportationId)",
      "cultureName": "en",
      "docUrl": "https://api-docs.beezup.com/#operation/EnableChannelCatalog",
      "message": "There is already an importation in progress: b24d0dd8-a561-478a-9b26-34f573f03527\n"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="get-public-channel-index-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Channel list regrouped by country and links to list of values|[publicChannelIndex](#schemapublicchannelindex)|
|304|Not Modified|The ETag sent in the http header If-None-Match did not change. So you are up to date !|None|
|default|Default|Occurs when something goes wrong|[BeezUP.Common.ErrorResponseMessage](#schemabeezup.common.errorresponsemessage)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|304|ETag|string||ETag value to identify the current version of the resource\<br>For more details go to this link: http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7232#section-2.3<br>|
|304|Last-Modified|string|date-time|Last modification UTC date of the resource\<br>For more details go to this link: https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7232#section-2.2<br>|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## The channel list for one country

<a id="opIdGetChannels"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/public/channels/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept-Encoding: string'
```

`GET /v2/public/channels/{countryIsoCode}`

<h3 id="the-channel-list-for-one-country-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|countryIsoCode|path|string|true|The country iso code alpha 3 based on this: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-3#Decoding_table \<br>To know which country are available you have to use the operation: GetChannelsByCountry<br>|
|Accept-Encoding|header|[string]|true|Allows the client to indicate whether it accepts a compressed encoding to reduce traffic size.|
|If-None-Match|header|string|false|ETag value to identify the last known version of requested resource.\<br>To avoid useless exchange, we recommend you to indicate the ETag you previously got from this operation.\<br>If the ETag value does not match the response will be 200 to give you a new content, otherwise the response will be: 304 Not Modified, without any content.\<br>For more details go to this link: http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7232#section-2.3<br>|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "channels": [
    {
      "homeUrl": "http://www.amazon.fr",
      "logoUrl": "http://beezupcdn.blob.core.windows.net/comparators/Amazon%2520Direct%2520FRA.png",
      "name": "Amazon Direct FRA",
      "types": [
        "Marketplace"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "arguments": [
        {
          "name": "currentCatalogImportationId",
          "value": {}
        }
      ],
      "code": "CatalogImportationAlreadyInProgress(ExecutionId currentCatalogImportationId)",
      "cultureName": "en",
      "docUrl": "https://api-docs.beezup.com/#operation/EnableChannelCatalog",
      "message": "There is already an importation in progress: b24d0dd8-a561-478a-9b26-34f573f03527\n"
    }
  ]
}
```

> default Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "arguments": [
        {
          "name": "currentCatalogImportationId",
          "value": {}
        }
      ],
      "code": "CatalogImportationAlreadyInProgress(ExecutionId currentCatalogImportationId)",
      "cultureName": "en",
      "docUrl": "https://api-docs.beezup.com/#operation/EnableChannelCatalog",
      "message": "There is already an importation in progress: b24d0dd8-a561-478a-9b26-34f573f03527\n"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="the-channel-list-for-one-country-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The channel list for one country|[publicChannelInfoList](#schemapublicchannelinfolist)|
|304|Not Modified|The ETag sent in the http header If-None-Match did not change. So you are up to date !|None|
|404|Not Found|Channel country not found|[BeezUP.Common.ErrorResponseMessage](#schemabeezup.common.errorresponsemessage)|
|default|Default|Occurs when something goes wrong|[BeezUP.Common.ErrorResponseMessage](#schemabeezup.common.errorresponsemessage)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|304|ETag|string||ETag value to identify the current version of the resource\<br>For more details go to this link: http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7232#section-2.3<br>|

<h3 id="get-the-list-of-values-related-to-this-list-name-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The list of values|[userListOfValuesResponse](#schemauserlistofvaluesresponse)|
|304|Not Modified|The ETag sent in the http header If-None-Match did not change. So you can keep your version.|None|
|404|Not Found|List not found|[BeezUP.Common.ErrorResponseMessage](#schemabeezup.common.errorresponsemessage)|
|default|Default|Occurs when something goes wrong|[BeezUP.Common.ErrorResponseMessage](#schemabeezup.common.errorresponsemessage)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Cache-Control|[string]||Indicates the directive around the caching mechanisms.\<br>For more information, please go to this link: https://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec14.html#sec14.9<br>|
|200|Content-Language|[string]||Indicates the language use in the response|
|200|ETag|string||The ETag corresponding to the LOV Index|
|304|Cache-Control|[string]||Indicates the directive around the caching mechanisms.\<br>For more information, please go to this link: https://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec14.html#sec14.9<br>|
|304|ETag|string||The ETag corresponding to the LOV Index|

<h3 id="the-index-of-all-operations-and-lov-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|If-None-Match|header|string|false|ETag value to identify the last known version of requested resource.\<br>To avoid useless exchange, we recommend you to indicate the ETag you previously got from this operation.\<br>If the ETag value does not match the response will be 200 to give you a new content, otherwise the response will be: 304 Not Modified, without any content.\<br>For more details go to this link: http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7232#section-2.3<br>|

<h3 id="the-index-of-all-operations-and-lov-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[customerIndex](#schemacustomerindex)|
|304|Not Modified|The ETag sent in the http header If-None-Match did not change. So you are up to date !|None|
|default|Default|Occurs when something goes wrong|[BeezUP.Common.ErrorResponseMessage](#schemabeezup.common.errorresponsemessage)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|304|ETag|string||ETag value to identify the current version of the resource\<br>For more details go to this link: http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7232#section-2.3<br>|
|304|Last-Modified|string|date-time|Last modification UTC date of the resource\<br>For more details go to this link: https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7232#section-2.2<br>|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

<h1 id="beezup-merchant-api--customer---account">Customer - Account</h1>

## Get user account information

<a id="opIdGetUserAccountInfo"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/customer/account \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /v2/user/customer/account`

<h3 id="get-user-account-information-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|If-None-Match|header|string|false|ETag value to identify the last known version of requested resource.\<br>To avoid useless exchange, we recommend you to indicate the ETag you previously got from this operation.\<br>If the ETag value does not match the response will be 200 to give you a new content, otherwise the response will be: 304 Not Modified, without any content.\<br>For more details go to this link: http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7232#section-2.3<br>|

|default|Default|Occurs when something goes wrong|[BeezUP.Common.ErrorResponseMessage](#schemabeezup.common.errorresponsemessage)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|304|ETag|string||ETag value to identify the current version of the resource\<br>For more details go to this link: http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7232#section-2.3<br>|
|304|Last-Modified|string|date-time|Last modification UTC date of the resource\<br>For more details go to this link: https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7232#section-2.2<br>|

## Activate the user account

<a id="opIdActivateUserAccount"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/customer/account/activate \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '"string"'
```

`POST /v2/user/customer/account/activate`

> Body parameter

```json
"string"
```

<h3 id="activate-the-user-account-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|string(guid)|true|The email activation id received by email.|

<h3 id="get-store-list-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Store list|[storeList](#schemastorelist)|
|304|Not Modified|The ETag sent in the http header If-None-Match did not change. So you are up to date !|None|
|default|Default|Occurs when something goes wrong|[BeezUP.Common.ErrorResponseMessage](#schemabeezup.common.errorresponsemessage)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|304|ETag|string||ETag value to identify the current version of the resource\<br>For more details go to this link: http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7232#section-2.3<br>|
|304|Last-Modified|string|date-time|Last modification UTC date of the resource\<br>For more details go to this link: https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7232#section-2.2<br>|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Create a new store

<a id="opIdCreateStore"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/customer/stores \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "countryIsoCodeAlpha3": "DEU",
    "id": "64f43358-63a1-47f7-97ec-0301fc39956b",
    "name": "My Store",
    "sectors": [
      "ANIMALERIE",
      "AUTOMOTO"
    ],
    "url": "http://www.mystore.com"
  }'
```

`POST /v2/user/customer/stores`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "countryIsoCodeAlpha3": "DEU",
  "id": "64f43358-63a1-47f7-97ec-0301fc39956b",
  "name": "My Store",
  "sectors": [
    "ANIMALERIE",
    "AUTOMOTO"
  ],
  "url": "http://www.mystore.com"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-new-store-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[createStoreRequest](#schemacreatestorerequest)|true|none|
|» countryIsoCodeAlpha3|body|[storeCountryIsoCodeAlpha3](#schemastorecountryisocodealpha3)|true|The country iso code alpha 3 based on the list of values /user/lov/StoreCountry|
|» id|body|[BeezUP.Common.StoreId](#schemabeezup.common.storeid)|false|The store identifier|
|» name|body|[storeName](#schemastorename)|true|The store name. Must be unique.|
|» sectors|body|[storeSectors](#schemastoresectors)|true|The store's sectors based on the list of values /user/lov/ParamSector|
|» url|body|[storeUrl](#schemastoreurl)|true|The url of your store|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|The store has been created successfully. The http header Location contains the new resource url. The body contains the link to the new resource.|[links.getStoreLink](#schemalinks.getstorelink)|
|402|Payment Required|The maximum amount of store has been reached. Please upgrade your contract.|[errorResponseMessagePaymentRequired](#schemaerrorresponsemessagepaymentrequired)|
|409|Conflict|The customer has a store with the same name|[BeezUP.Common.ErrorResponseMessage](#schemabeezup.common.errorresponsemessage)|
|default|Default|Occurs when something goes wrong|[BeezUP.Common.ErrorResponseMessage](#schemabeezup.common.errorresponsemessage)|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Get store's information

<a id="opIdGetStore"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/customer/stores/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /v2/user/customer/stores/{storeId}`

<h3 id="get-stores-information-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|storeId|path|string(guid)|true|Your store identifier|
|If-None-Match|header|string|false|ETag value to identify the last known version of requested resource.\<br>To avoid useless exchange, we recommend you to indicate the ETag you previously got from this operation.\<br>If the ETag value does not match the response will be 200 to give you a new content, otherwise the response will be: 304 Not Modified, without any content.\<br>For more details go to this link: http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7232#section-2.3<br>|

## Update some store's information.

<a id="opIdUpdateStore"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/customer/stores/string \

  -d '{
```

`PATCH /v2/user/customer/stores/{storeId}`

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Contract list|[contracts](#schemacontracts)|
|304|Not Modified|The ETag sent in the http header If-None-Match did not change. So you are up to date !|None|
|default|Default|Occurs when something goes wrong|[BeezUP.Common.ErrorResponseMessage](#schemabeezup.common.errorresponsemessage)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|304|ETag|string||ETag value to identify the current version of the resource\<br>For more details go to this link: http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7232#section-2.3<br>|
|304|Last-Modified|string|date-time|Last modification UTC date of the resource\<br>For more details go to this link: https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7232#section-2.2<br>|

## Create a new contract

<a id="opIdCreateContract"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/customer/contracts \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "billingPeriodInMonth": "12",
    "couponDiscountCode": "I-LOVE-BEEZUP",
    "couponOfferCode": "04efc310-bc25-4710-a83a-faf200284fe5",
    "offerId": "1",
    "storeCount": "1"
  }'
```

`POST /v2/user/customer/contracts`

Now you are ready to create your contract. Before that, please ensure that you check the offer with the same request parameterts. /offers


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "billingPeriodInMonth": "12",
  "couponDiscountCode": "I-LOVE-BEEZUP",
  "couponOfferCode": "04efc310-bc25-4710-a83a-faf200284fe5",
  "offerId": "1",
  "storeCount": "1"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-new-contract-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[createContract](#schemacreatecontract)|true|none|
|» billingPeriodInMonth|body|[billingPeriodInMonth](#schemabillingperiodinmonth)|true|Can be null. The billing period in month based on /billingPeriods|
|» couponDiscountCode|body|[couponDiscountCode](#schemacoupondiscountcode)|false|The coupon discount code|
|» couponOfferCode|body|[couponOfferCode](#schemacouponoffercode)|false|Your special coupon offer identifier|
|» offerId|body|[offerId](#schemaofferid)|true|The offer id based on /offers. Not a free offer of course.|
|» storeCount|body|[storeCount](#schemastorecount)|true|The store count you want to have in your contract.|

## Schedule termination of your current contract at the end of the commitment.

<a id="opIdTerminateCurrentContract"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/customer/contracts/current/disableAutoRenewal \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "contractTerminationReason": "I'\''m crazy, I want to leave your splendid service...",
    "contractTerminationReasonType": "1"
  }'
```

`POST /v2/user/customer/contracts/current/disableAutoRenewal`

By default your contract are automatically renew. By calling this operation you can disable the auto renewal.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "contractTerminationReason": "I'm crazy, I want to leave your splendid service...",
  "contractTerminationReasonType": "1"
}
```

<h3 id="schedule-termination-of-your-current-contract-at-the-end-of-the-commitment-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[terminateContract](#schematerminatecontract)|true|Indicate the termination reason|
|» contractTerminationReason|body|[contractTerminationReason](#schemacontractterminationreason)|false|The termination reason, if your current contract is scheduled to be terminated.|
|» contractTerminationReasonType|body|[contractTerminationReasonType](#schemacontractterminationreasontype)|true|The contract termination reason type identifier, if your current contract is scheduled to be terminated. The value is based on the list of values /user/lov/ContractTerminationReason|

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/customer/offers \
```

```bash
  -d '{
    "billingPeriodInMonth": "12",

  }'
```

`POST /v2/user/customer/offers`

Get the offer pricing then you can create your contract with the same request parameters. /v2/user/customer/contracts


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "billingPeriodInMonth": "12",
  "couponDiscountCode": "I-LOVE-BEEZUP",
  "couponOfferCode": "04efc310-bc25-4710-a83a-faf200284fe5",
  "offerId": "1",
  "storeCount": "1"
}
```

<h3 id="get-offer-pricing-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[offerRequest](#schemaofferrequest)|true|none|
|» billingPeriodInMonth|body|[billingPeriodInMonth](#schemabillingperiodinmonth)|true|Can be null. The billing period in month based on /billingPeriods|
|» couponDiscountCode|body|[couponDiscountCode](#schemacoupondiscountcode)|false|The coupon discount code|
|» couponOfferCode|body|[couponOfferCode](#schemacouponoffercode)|false|Your special coupon offer identifier|
|» offerId|body|[offerId](#schemaofferid)|true|The offer id based on /offers. Not a free offer of course.|

## Configure Auto Import Schedules

<a id="opIdAuto_ScheduleAutoImport"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/catalogs/string/autoImport/scheduling/schedules \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "localTimeZoneName": "Romance Standard Time",
    "schedules": [
      "21:00:00",
      "23:00:00",
      "08:30:00"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /v2/user/catalogs/{storeId}/autoImport/scheduling/schedules`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "localTimeZoneName": "Romance Standard Time",
  "schedules": [
    "21:00:00",
    "23:00:00",
    "08:30:00"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="configure-auto-import-schedules-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|storeId|path|string(guid)|true|Your store identifier|
|body|body|[scheduleAutoImportRequest](#schemascheduleautoimportrequest)|true|none|
|» localTimeZoneName|body|string|false|If null the local time zone name will be "Romance Standard Time"|
|» schedules|body|[string]|true|Indicate the time span you want to import your catalog. (i.e. "21:00:00" to import your catalog at 9PM)|

## Get the BeezUP columns

<a id="opIdCatalog_GetBeezUPColumns"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/catalogs/beezupColumns \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /v2/user/catalogs/beezupColumns`

Get the BeezUP columns, this columns are used for mapping during the manual catalog importation process.

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "beezUPColumnName": "CategoryFirstLevel",
    "canBeTruncated": "false",
    "columnDataType": "String",
    "columnImportance": "Required",
    "description": "Use for big text, like description",
    "displayGroupName": "Category",
    "unique": "false"
  }
]
```

> default Response

```json
{
  "errors": [
    {
      "arguments": [
        {
          "name": "currentCatalogImportationId",
          "value": {}
        }
      ],
      "code": "CatalogImportationAlreadyInProgress(ExecutionId currentCatalogImportationId)",
      "cultureName": "en",
      "docUrl": "https://api-docs.beezup.com/#operation/EnableChannelCatalog",
      "message": "There is already an importation in progress: b24d0dd8-a561-478a-9b26-34f573f03527\n"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="get-the-beezup-columns-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The catalog API index|Inline|
|default|Default|Occurs when something goes wrong|[BeezUP.Common.ErrorResponseMessage](#schemabeezup.common.errorresponsemessage)|

<h3 id="get-the-beezup-columns-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[beezUPColumnConfiguration](#schemabeezupcolumnconfiguration)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Start Manual Import

<a id="opIdImportation_StartManualUpdate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/catalogs/string/importations/start \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "duplicateProductSkuConfiguration": {
      "compareOptions": "IgnoreCase",
      "strategy": "KeepFirstDuplicateProductOnly"
    },
    "input": {
      "files": [
        {
          "fetch": {
            "compressedRelativePath": "folder/file.xxx",
            "compressionFormatStrategy": "None",
            "credential": {
              "password": "MyPassword",
              "userName": "MyLogin"
            },
            "downloadCatalogStrategy": "SimpleUri",
            "downloadTimeout": "360",
            "uri": "http://www.mywebsite.com/mycatalog.csv"
          },
          "fileNumber": "1",
          "read": {
            "csvFileReadProperties": {
              "csvSeparator": ";",
              "csvTextQualifier": "\"",
              "hasHeaderRecord": "true",
              "ignoreHeaderRecord": "true"
            },
            "cultureName": "fr-FR",
            "encodingTypeName": "UTF-8",
            "format": "Csv",
            "xmlFileReadProperties": {
              "flattenXmlChildElements": "true",
              "useXmlAttributes": "true"
            }
          }
        }
      ],
      "transformFileUrl": "http://beezupblob.com/Mytransformation.xslt"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /v2/user/catalogs/{storeId}/importations/start`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "duplicateProductSkuConfiguration": {
    "compareOptions": "IgnoreCase",
    "strategy": "KeepFirstDuplicateProductOnly"
  },
  "input": {
    "files": [
      {
        "fetch": {
          "compressedRelativePath": "folder/file.xxx",
          "compressionFormatStrategy": "None",
          "credential": {
            "password": "MyPassword",
            "userName": "MyLogin"
          },
          "downloadCatalogStrategy": "SimpleUri",
          "downloadTimeout": "360",
          "uri": "http://www.mywebsite.com/mycatalog.csv"
        },
        "fileNumber": "1",
        "read": {
          "csvFileReadProperties": {
            "csvSeparator": ";",
            "csvTextQualifier": "\"",
            "hasHeaderRecord": "true",
            "ignoreHeaderRecord": "true"
          },
          "cultureName": "fr-FR",
          "encodingTypeName": "UTF-8",
          "format": "Csv",

            "flattenXmlChildElements": "true",
            "useXmlAttributes": "true"

  }
}
```

<h3 id="start-manual-import-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

|body|body|[startManualImportRequest](#schemastartmanualimportrequest)|true|none|
|» duplicateProductSkuConfiguration|body|[duplicateProductValueConfiguration](#schemaduplicateproductvalueconfiguration)|false|Describe how you want to manage the duplication of the product value|
|» input|body|[inputConfiguration](#schemainputconfiguration)|true|Describe the input configuration|

<h3 id="start-manual-import-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|202|Accepted|Catalog importation started|[links.Importation_GetImportationMonitoringLink](#schemalinks.importation_getimportationmonitoringlink)|
|400|Bad Request|Missing Input configuration in the request<br>Occurs when there is a duplicate file number in the input configuration<br>Occurs when there is a duplicate file Uri in the input configuration|[BeezUP.Common.ErrorResponseMessage](#schemabeezup.common.errorresponsemessage)|
|404|Not Found|StoreId not found|[BeezUP.Common.ErrorResponseMessage](#schemabeezup.common.errorresponsemessage)|
|409|Conflict|A catalog importation is already in progress!|[importAlreadyInProgressResponse](#schemaimportalreadyinprogressresponse)|
|default|Default|Occurs when something goes wrong|[BeezUP.Common.ErrorResponseMessage](#schemabeezup.common.errorresponsemessage)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|202|Location|string||The location of the new resource to poll|
|202|Retry-After|integer||The duration in second to wait before polling this resource|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Get the importation status

<a id="opIdImportation_GetImportationMonitoring"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/catalogs/string/importations/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /v2/user/catalogs/{storeId}/importations/{executionId}`

<h3 id="get-the-importation-status-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|storeId|path|string(guid)|true|Your store identifier|
|executionId|path|string(guid)|true|The execution identifier of you catalog importation|

## Configure catalog column

<a id="opIdImportation_ConfigureCatalogColumn"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/catalogs/string/importations/string/catalogColumns/string \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "catalogColumn": {
      "catalogColumnName": "SKU",
      "configuration": {
        "beezUPColumnName": "CategoryFirstLevel",
        "canBeTruncated": "false",
        "columnCultureName": "fr-FR",
        "columnDataType": "String",
        "columnFormat": "MM/dd/yyyy",
        "columnImportance": "Required",
        "displayGroupName": "Category"
      },
      "duplicateProductValueConfiguration": {
        "compareOptions": "IgnoreCase",
        "strategy": "KeepFirstDuplicateProductOnly"
      },
      "id": "8a76f06a-fefc-4c0d-bcfe-b210f1482977",
      "ignored": "true",
      "userColumName": "My SKU"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /v2/user/catalogs/{storeId}/importations/{executionId}/catalogColumns/{columnId}`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "catalogColumn": {
    "catalogColumnName": "SKU",
    "configuration": {

  }
}
```

## Create or replace a custom column

<a id="opIdImportation_SaveCustomColumn"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/catalogs/string/importations/string/customColumns/string \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "encryptedBlocklyExpression": "apokpoa,opz,sixsoisiosnoisn",
    "encryptedExpression": "uziushdczaniodnndonisodndsiondsoidsndoin",
    "userColumName": "My SKU"
  }'
```

`PUT /v2/user/catalogs/{storeId}/importations/{executionId}/customColumns/{columnId}`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "encryptedBlocklyExpression": "apokpoa,opz,sixsoisiosnoisn",
  "encryptedExpression": "uziushdczaniodnndonisodndsiondsoidsndoin",
  "userColumName": "My SKU"
}
```

<h3 id="create-or-replace-a-custom-column-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|storeId|path|string(guid)|true|Your store identifier|
|executionId|path|string(guid)|true|The execution identifier of you catalog importation|
|columnId|path|string(guid)|true|The custom column identifier|
|body|body|[changeCustomColumnRequest](#schemachangecustomcolumnrequest)|true|none|
|» encryptedBlocklyExpression|body|[encryptedBlocklyExpression](#schemaencryptedblocklyexpression)|true|The encrypted XML Blockly representation of the expression|
|» encryptedExpression|body|[encryptedExpression](#schemaencryptedexpression)|true|The encrypted excel expression of the column|
|» userColumName|body|[userColumName](#schemausercolumname)|true|Column named by the user|

|409|Conflict|Occurs when this importation is already finished.|[BeezUP.Common.ErrorResponseMessage](#schemabeezup.common.errorresponsemessage)|
|default|Default|Occurs when something goes wrong|[BeezUP.Common.ErrorResponseMessage](#schemabeezup.common.errorresponsemessage)|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Get catalog column list

<a id="opIdCatalog_GetCatalogColumns"></a>

```bash
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

<h3 id="get-catalog-column-list-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|storeId|path|string(guid)|true|Your store identifier|

## Change Catalog Column User Name

<a id="opIdCatalog_ChangeCatalogColumnUserName"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/catalogs/string/catalogColumns/string/rename \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "userColumName": "My SKU"
  }'
```

`POST /v2/user/catalogs/{storeId}/catalogColumns/{columnId}/rename`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "userColumName": "My SKU"
}
```

<h3 id="change-catalog-column-user-name-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|storeId|path|string(guid)|true|Your store identifier|
|columnId|path|string(guid)|true|The catalog column identifier|
|body|body|[changeUserColumnNameRequest](#schemachangeusercolumnnamerequest)|true|none|
|» userColumName|body|[userColumName](#schemausercolumname)|true|Column named by the user|

<h3 id="change-catalog-column-user-name-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Catalog column user name changed|None|
|400|Bad Request|When a user column name is duplicate.|[BeezUP.Common.ErrorResponseMessage](#schemabeezup.common.errorresponsemessage)|
|404|Not Found|Occurs when a user tries to work on the wrong store.<br>Occurs when a catalog column is not found.|[BeezUP.Common.ErrorResponseMessage](#schemabeezup.common.errorresponsemessage)|
|409|Conflict|A catalog importation is already in progress!|[importAlreadyInProgressResponse](#schemaimportalreadyinprogressresponse)|
|default|Default|Occurs when something goes wrong|[BeezUP.Common.ErrorResponseMessage](#schemabeezup.common.errorresponsemessage)|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Get category list

<a id="opIdCatalog_GetCategories"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/catalogs/string/categories \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept-Encoding: string'
```

`GET /v2/user/catalogs/{storeId}/categories`

<h3 id="get-category-list-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|storeId|path|string(guid)|true|Your store identifier|
|Accept-Encoding|header|[string]|true|Indicates that the client accepts that the response will be compressed to reduce traffic size.|

## Create or replace a custom column

<a id="opIdCatalog_SaveCustomColumn"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/catalogs/string/customColumns/string \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "displayGroupName": "Category",
    "encryptedBlocklyExpression": "apokpoa,opz,sixsoisiosnoisn",
    "encryptedExpression": "uziushdczaniodnndonisodndsiondsoidsndoin",
    "userColumnName": "My SKU"
  }'
```

`PUT /v2/user/catalogs/{storeId}/customColumns/{columnId}`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "displayGroupName": "Category",
  "encryptedBlocklyExpression": "apokpoa,opz,sixsoisiosnoisn",
  "encryptedExpression": "uziushdczaniodnndonisodndsiondsoidsndoin",
  "userColumnName": "My SKU"
}
```

|body|body|[createCustomColumnRequest](#schemacreatecustomcolumnrequest)|true|none|
|» displayGroupName|body|[displayGroupName](#schemadisplaygroupname)|true|Indicate the display group name where the column must be putted|
|» encryptedBlocklyExpression|body|[encryptedBlocklyExpression](#schemaencryptedblocklyexpression)|true|The encrypted XML Blockly representation of the expression|
|» encryptedExpression|body|[encryptedExpression](#schemaencryptedexpression)|true|The encrypted excel expression of the column|

## Change custom column expression

<a id="opIdCatalog_ChangeCustomColumnExpression"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/catalogs/string/customColumns/string/expression \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "encryptedBlocklyExpression": "apokpoa,opz,sixsoisiosnoisn",
    "encryptedExpression": "uziushdczaniodnndonisodndsiondsoidsndoin"
  }'
```

`PUT /v2/user/catalogs/{storeId}/customColumns/{columnId}/expression`

> Body parameter

```json
{

}
```

|» encryptedBlocklyExpression|body|[encryptedBlocklyExpression](#schemaencryptedblocklyexpression)|true|The encrypted XML Blockly representation of the expression|

|» pageSize|body|[BeezUP.Common.PageSize](#schemabeezup.common.pagesize)|true|Indicate the item count per page|
|» productIdList|body|[[BeezUP.Common.ProductId](#schemabeezup.common.productid)]|false|Filter with a list of product identifier|
|» sku|body|string|false|Search for product by sku|
|» title|body|string|false|Search for products containing this title|
|» withoutSubCategories|body|boolean|false|Do not retrieve sub categories. By default, this value is set to false|

## Add a new channel catalog

<a id="opIdAddChannelCatalog"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/channelCatalogs/ \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "channelId": "2dc136a7-0d3d-4cc9-a825-a28a42c53e28",
    "storeId": "64f43358-63a1-47f7-97ec-0301fc39956b"
  }'
```

`POST /v2/user/channelCatalogs/`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "channelId": "2dc136a7-0d3d-4cc9-a825-a28a42c53e28",
  "storeId": "64f43358-63a1-47f7-97ec-0301fc39956b"
}
```

```json
        }
      ],
      "code": "CatalogImportationAlreadyInProgress(ExecutionId currentCatalogImportationId)",
      "cultureName": "en",
      "docUrl": "https://api-docs.beezup.com/#operation/EnableChannelCatalog",
      "message": "There is already an importation in progress: b24d0dd8-a561-478a-9b26-34f573f03527\n"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-new-channel-catalog-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|When the channel has been successfully added for this store|[links.GetChannelCatalogLink](#schemalinks.getchannelcataloglink)|
|404|Not Found|StoreId not found or not authorized|[BeezUP.Common.ErrorResponseMessage](#schemabeezup.common.errorresponsemessage)|
|default|Default|Occurs when something goes wrong|[BeezUP.Common.ErrorResponseMessage](#schemabeezup.common.errorresponsemessage)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|201|Location|string||The new location|
|201|Retry-After|integer||The duration in second to wait before polling this resource|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

```json
        }
```

<h3 id="get-channel-catalog-filter-operators-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|

<h3 id="get-channel-catalog-filter-operators-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|*anonymous*|[[filterOperator](#schemafilteroperator)]|false|none|none|

## Configure channel catalog cost settings

<a id="opIdConfigureChannelCatalogCostSettings"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/channelCatalogs/6d6b04de-406b-4539-8e7e-bf3e8da5dfb0/settings/cost \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "costType": "Fixed_Global",
    "globalCostValue": "10.21"
  }'
```

`PUT /v2/user/channelCatalogs/{channelCatalogId}/settings/cost`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "costType": "Fixed_Global",
  "globalCostValue": "10.21"
}
```

<h3 id="configure-channel-catalog-cost-settings-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channelCatalogId|path|string(guid)|true|The channel catalog identifier|
|body|body|[costSettings](#schemacostsettings)|true|none|
|» costType|body|[costType](#schemacosttype)|true|CPC means cost per click.<br>CPA means cost per action.<br>You can have CPC/CPA with a global cost value.<br>You can have CPC/CPA by category the cost value MUST be null<br>You can have global fixed price.<br>|
|» globalCostValue|body|number(decimal)|false|In case of global cost type, you have to indicate the cost value.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» costType|CPC_Global|
|» costType|CPA_Global|
|» costType|CPC_ByCategory|
|» costType|CPA_ByCategory|
|» costType|Fixed_Global|

## Configure channel catalog category

<a id="opIdConfigureChannelCatalogCategory"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/channelCatalogs/6d6b04de-406b-4539-8e7e-bf3e8da5dfb0/categories/configure \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "channelCatalogCategories": [
      {
        "autoMapNewSubCategories": "true",
        "catalogCategoryPath": [
          "Vêtements",
          "Femmes",
          "Chaussures"
        ],
        "channelCategoryPath": [
          "Clothing",
          "Women",
          "Shoes"
        ],
        "costValue": "10.21"
      }
    ],
    "overrideSubCategoryMappings": "true"
  }'
```

`POST /v2/user/channelCatalogs/{channelCatalogId}/categories/configure`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "channelCatalogCategories": [
    {
      "autoMapNewSubCategories": "true",
      "catalogCategoryPath": [
        "Vêtements",
        "Femmes",
        "Chaussures"
      ],
      "channelCategoryPath": [
        "Clothing",
        "Women",
        "Shoes"
      ],
      "costValue": "10.21"
    }
  ],
  "overrideSubCategoryMappings": "true"
}
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|» channelCatalogCategories|body|[[channelCatalogCategoryConfiguration](#schemachannelcatalogcategoryconfiguration)]|true|none|
|» overrideSubCategoryMappings|body|boolean|true|Great feature! In case of mapping to parent channel category, you can ask to override the mapping of all sub channel category to this catalog category path|

## Configure channel catalog exclusion filters

<a id="opIdConfigureChannelCatalogExclusionFilters"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/channelCatalogs/6d6b04de-406b-4539-8e7e-bf3e8da5dfb0/exclusionFilters \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '[
    {
      "channelColumnId": "8a76f06a-fefc-4c0d-bcfe-b210f1482977",
      "enabled": "true",
      "groupId": "d9833f4b-718a-436f-bab5-89da3d21bf60",
      "name": "Exclude sony products",
      "operatorName": "Contains",
      "position": "1",
      "positionInGroup": "1",
      "value": "sony"
    }
  ]'
```

`PUT /v2/user/channelCatalogs/{channelCatalogId}/exclusionFilters`

> Body parameter

```json
[
  {
    "channelColumnId": "8a76f06a-fefc-4c0d-bcfe-b210f1482977",
    "enabled": "true",
    "groupId": "d9833f4b-718a-436f-bab5-89da3d21bf60",
    "name": "Exclude sony products",

    "position": "1",
    "positionInGroup": "1",
    "value": "sony"
  }
]
```

|body|body|[exclusionFilters](#schemaexclusionfilters)|true|none|

<h1 id="beezup-merchant-api--channel-catalogs---products">Channel Catalogs - Products</h1>

## Get channel catalog products related to these channel catalogs

<a id="opIdGetChannelCatalogProductByChannelCatalog"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/channelCatalogs/products \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "channelCatalogIds": [
      "6d6b04de-406b-4539-8e7e-bf3e8da5dfb0"
    ],
    "productId": "578419df-1bbf-41a6-96fa-862e42182b67",
    "storeId": "64f43358-63a1-47f7-97ec-0301fc39956b"
  }'
```

```json
{
```

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/channelCatalogs/6d6b04de-406b-4539-8e7e-bf3e8da5dfb0/products \

  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \

    "catalogCategoryFilter": {
      "categoryPath": [
        "Maison",

        "Home",
```

|» pageSize|body|integer(int32)|true|none|
|» productFilters|body|[channelCatalogProductFilters](#schemachannelcatalogproductfilters)|false|none|

```json
  }
}
```

<h3 id="export-channel-catalog-product-information-list-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channelCatalogId|path|string(guid)|true|The channel catalog identifier|
|format|query|string|true|The file type of the exportation|
|body|body|[getChannelCatalogProductInfoListRequest](#schemagetchannelcatalogproductinfolistrequest)|true|The channel catalog product list filter|
|» catalogCategoryFilter|body|[BeezUP.Common.CatalogCategoryFilter](#schemabeezup.common.catalogcategoryfilter)|false|none|
|» channelCategoryFilter|body|[BeezUP.Common.ChannelCategoryFilter](#schemabeezup.common.channelcategoryfilter)|false|none|
|» criteria|body|[productSetVisibilityCriteria](#schemaproductsetvisibilitycriteria)|true|none|
|» overridden|body|boolean|false|Search overridden products. If null the filter will not be taken in account.|
|» pageNumber|body|integer(int32)|true|none|
|» pageSize|body|integer(int32)|true|none|
|» productFilters|body|[channelCatalogProductFilters](#schemachannelcatalogproductfilters)|false|none|

## [PREVIEW] Launch a publication of the catalog to the marketplace

<a id="opIdPublishCatalogToMarketplace"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/marketplaces/channelcatalogs/publications/string/0/publish \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "feedType": "Offers",
    "publicationStrategyKind": "Delta",
    "withUnpublish": true
  }'
```

`POST /v2/user/marketplaces/channelcatalogs/publications/{marketplaceTechnicalCode}/{accountId}/publish`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "feedType": "Offers",
  "publicationStrategyKind": "Delta",
  "withUnpublish": true
}
```

<h3 id="preview-launch-a-publication-of-the-catalog-to-the-marketplace-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|marketplaceTechnicalCode|path|string|true|Marketplace Technical Code to query (required)|
|accountId|path|integer(int32)|true|Account Id to query (required)|
|body|body|[publishCatalogToMarketplaceRequest](#schemapublishcatalogtomarketplacerequest)|true|none|
|» feedType|body|[feedType](#schemafeedtype)|true|The Feed Type|
|» publicationStrategyKind|body|[publicationStrategyKind](#schemapublicationstrategykind)|true|Define the publication strategy kind, for that you have 2 choices <br>* Delta - This is the recommanded publication strategy kind, this strategy will push to the marketplace only the difference between your catalog and the previous published feeds done by BeezUP. <br>* Full - If you want to force the publication of all your catalog feeds to the marketplace. <br>      !WARNING! Depending to the marketplace this operation will purge the existing offers on the marketplace that are not in the catalog or unknown from the publication feed referential.<br>|
|» withUnpublish|body|boolean|true|In full publication strategy kind, for some marktetplace, you can ask to unpublish or not your existing feeds on the markeptlace absent from your exported catalog.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» feedType|Products|
|» feedType|Inventory|
|» feedType|Pricing|
|» feedType|Images|
|» feedType|Relationships|
|» feedType|Unpublish|
|» feedType|Offers|
|» publicationStrategyKind|Delta|
|» publicationStrategyKind|Full|

```bash
  -d '{

      {
```
```json
        "accountId": "1234",
```
```json
        "enabled": "false",
        "marketplaceTechnicalCode": "Amazon",
```
```bash
        "orderStatusTransitionId": "1234"
      }
    ]
```

<h3 id="configure-new-or-existing-automatic-order-status-transition-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Successfully confirugred new or existing automatic Order status transition|None|
|400|Bad Request|Requested automatic Order status transition could not be configured|[BeezUP.Common.ErrorResponseMessage](#schemabeezup.common.errorresponsemessage)|
|default|Default|Occurs when something goes wrong|[BeezUP.Common.ErrorResponseMessage](#schemabeezup.common.errorresponsemessage)|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

<h1 id="beezup-merchant-api--marketplaces---orders---list">Marketplaces - Orders - List</h1>

## [DEPRECATED] Get a paginated list of all Orders with all Order and Order Item(s) properties

<a id="opIdGetOrderListFull"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/marketplaces/orders/list/full \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept-Encoding: string' \
  -d '{
    "accountIds": [
      "12345"
    ],
    "beezUPOrderStatuses": [
      "InProgress"
    ],
    "beginPeriodUtcDate": "2017-03-01T13:10:01Z",
    "dateSearchType": "Modification",
    "endPeriodUtcDate": "2017-04-01T13:10:01Z",
    "invoiceAvailabilityType": "All",
    "marketplaceBusinessCodes": [
      "PRICEMINISTER"
    ],
    "marketplaceOrderIds": [
      "AmazonOrderId1234"
    ],
    "marketplaceTechnicalCodes": [
      "PriceMinister"
    ],
    "orderMerchantInfoSynchronizationStatus": "All",
    "order_Buyer_Name": "Monroe",
    "order_MerchantOrderIds": [
      "MyOrderId1234"
    ],
    "storeIds": [
      "64f43358-63a1-47f7-97ec-0301fc39956b"
    ],
    "pageNumber": "1",
    "pageSize": "100"
  }'
```

`POST /v2/user/marketplaces/orders/list/full`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

DEPRECATED - Use /orders/v3 instead
The purpose of this operation is to reduce the amount of request to the API.\
\
Previous implmentation of this feature only returned a partial (light) version of the Orders. The purpose of this API is to reduce the number of incoming requests by returning the complete (full) Order and Order Item(s) properties.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "accountIds": [
    "12345"
  ],
  "beezUPOrderStatuses": [
    "InProgress"
  ],
  "beginPeriodUtcDate": "2017-03-01T13:10:01Z",
  "dateSearchType": "Modification",
  "endPeriodUtcDate": "2017-04-01T13:10:01Z",
  "invoiceAvailabilityType": "All",

  ],

  ],

    "PriceMinister"
  ],

  "order_Buyer_Name": "Monroe",
  "order_MerchantOrderIds": [
    "MyOrderId1234"
  ],

  ],

  "pageSize": "100"
}
```

<h3 id="deprecated-get-a-paginated-list-of-all-orders-with-all-order-and-order-items-properties-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Accept-Encoding|header|[string]|true|Allows the client to indicate wether it accepts a compressed encoding to reduce traffic size|
|body|body|[orderListRequest](#schemaorderlistrequest)|true|none|
|» accountIds|body|[[accountId](#schemaaccountid)]|false|Account Id list|
|» beezUPOrderStatuses|body|[[beezUPOrderStatus](#schemabeezuporderstatus)]|false|none|
|» beginPeriodUtcDate|body|string(date-time)|true|The begin period you want to make the search. \<br>The period MUST not be greater than 62 days.<br>The begin period MUST be lower than the end period.<br>|
|» dateSearchType|body|[dateSearchType](#schemadatesearchtype)|false|Indicates on which date you want to make the filter|
|» endPeriodUtcDate|body|string(date-time)|true|The end period of you search. \<br>The period MUST not be greater than 62 days. \<br>The end period MUST be greater than the begin period.<br>The end period MUST be lower to the current date.<br>|
|» invoiceAvailabilityType|body|[invoiceAvailabilityType](#schemainvoiceavailabilitytype)|false|Indicates on which invoice availability to filter|
|» marketplaceBusinessCodes|body|[[BeezUP.Common.MarketplaceBusinessCode](#schemabeezup.common.marketplacebusinesscode)]|false|none|
|» marketplaceOrderIds|body|[[marketplaceOrderId](#schemamarketplaceorderid)]|false|none|
|» marketplaceTechnicalCodes|body|[[BeezUP.Common.MarketplaceTechnicalCode](#schemabeezup.common.marketplacetechnicalcode)]|false|none|
|» orderMerchantInfoSynchronizationStatus|body|[orderMerchantInfoSynchronizationStatus](#schemaordermerchantinfosynchronizationstatus)|false|Indicates on which order merchant info synchronization status to filter|
|» order_Buyer_Name|body|[order_Buyer_Name](#schemaorder_buyer_name)|false|Buyer full name|
|» order_MerchantOrderIds|body|[[order_MerchantOrderId](#schemaorder_merchantorderid)]|false|Merchant order id list|
|» storeIds|body|[[BeezUP.Common.StoreId](#schemabeezup.common.storeid)]|false|Store Id list|
|» pageNumber|body|[pageNumber](#schemapagenumber)|true|Indicates the page number|
|» pageSize|body|[pageSize](#schemapagesize)|true|Indicate the order count per page|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» dateSearchType|Modification|
|» dateSearchType|Purchase|
|» dateSearchType|MarketPlaceModification|

|400|Bad Request|Could not process request for given parameters values. Please check error message for more details.|[BeezUP.Common.ErrorResponseMessage](#schemabeezup.common.errorresponsemessage)|
|default|Default|Occurs when something goes wrong|[BeezUP.Common.ErrorResponseMessage](#schemabeezup.common.errorresponsemessage)|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

|» endPeriodUtcDate|body|string(date-time)|true|The end period of you search. \<br>The period MUST not be greater than 62 days. \<br>The end period MUST be greater than the begin period.<br>The end period MUST be lower to the current date.<br>|

|» marketplaceOrderIds|body|[[marketplaceOrderId](#schemamarketplaceorderid)]|false|none|

|» order_MerchantOrderIds|body|[[order_MerchantOrderId](#schemaorder_merchantorderid)]|false|Merchant order id list|
|» storeIds|body|[[BeezUP.Common.StoreId](#schemabeezup.common.storeid)]|false|Store Id list|

<a id="opIdGetOrderExportations"></a>

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/v2/user/marketplaces/orders/exportations?pageNumber=1&pageSize=25&storeId=string' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /v2/user/marketplaces/orders/exportations`

<h3 id="get-a-paginated-list-of-order-report-exportations-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|pageNumber|query|integer(int32)|true|The page number you want to get|
|pageSize|query|integer(int32)|true|The entry count you want to get|
|storeId|query|string(guid)|true|The store identifier to regroup the order exportations|
|If-None-Match|header|string|false|ETag value to identify the last known version of requested resource.\<br>To avoid useless exchange, we recommend you to indicate the ETag you previously got from this operation.\<br>If the ETag value does not match the response will be 200 to give you a new content, otherwise the response will be: 304 Not Modified, without any content.\<br>For more details go to this link: http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7232#section-2.3<br>|

```json
      "blobNameUri": "http://beezuporder2.blob.com/yourReport.csv",
```

## Get a paginated list of all Orders with all Order and Order Item(s) properties

<a id="opIdGetOrderListFullV3"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/orders/v3/list/full \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept-Encoding: string' \
  -d '{
    "accountIds": [
      "12345"
    ],
    "beezUPOrderStatuses": [
      "InProgress"
    ],
    "beginPeriodUtcDate": "2017-03-01T13:10:01Z",
    "dateSearchType": "Modification",
    "endPeriodUtcDate": "2017-04-01T13:10:01Z",
    "invoiceAvailabilityType": "All",
    "marketplaceBusinessCodes": [
      "PRICEMINISTER"
    ],
    "marketplaceOrderIds": [
      "AmazonOrderId1234"
    ],
    "marketplaceTechnicalCodes": [
      "PriceMinister"
    ],
    "orderMerchantInfoSynchronizationStatus": "All",
    "order_Buyer_Name": "Monroe",
    "order_MerchantOrderIds": [
      "MyOrderId1234"
    ],
    "storeIds": [
      "64f43358-63a1-47f7-97ec-0301fc39956b"
    ],
    "pageNumber": "1",
    "pageSize": "100"
  }'
```

`POST /orders/v3/list/full`

The purpose of this operation is to reduce the amount of request to the API.\
\
Previous implmentation of this feature only returned a partial (light) version of the Orders. The purpose of this API is to reduce the number of incoming requests by returning the complete (full) Order and Order Item(s) properties.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "accountIds": [
    "12345"
  ],
  "beezUPOrderStatuses": [
```

<h3 id="get-a-paginated-list-of-all-orders-with-all-order-and-order-items-properties-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Accept-Encoding|header|string|true|Allows the client to indicate wether it accepts a compressed encoding to reduce traffic size|
|body|body|[orderListRequest](#schemaorderlistrequest)|true|none|
|» accountIds|body|[[accountId](#schemaaccountid)]|false|Account Id list|
|» beezUPOrderStatuses|body|[[beezUPOrderStatus](#schemabeezuporderstatus)]|false|none|
|» beginPeriodUtcDate|body|string(date-time)|true|The begin period you want to make the search. \<br>The period MUST not be greater than 62 days.<br>The begin period MUST be lower than the end period.<br>|
|» dateSearchType|body|[dateSearchType](#schemadatesearchtype)|false|Indicates on which date you want to make the filter|
|» endPeriodUtcDate|body|string(date-time)|true|The end period of you search. \<br>The period MUST not be greater than 62 days. \<br>The end period MUST be greater than the begin period.<br>The end period MUST be lower to the current date.<br>|
|» invoiceAvailabilityType|body|[invoiceAvailabilityType](#schemainvoiceavailabilitytype)|false|Indicates on which invoice availability to filter|
|» marketplaceBusinessCodes|body|[[BeezUP.Common.MarketplaceBusinessCode](#schemabeezup.common.marketplacebusinesscode)]|false|none|
|» marketplaceOrderIds|body|[[marketplaceOrderId](#schemamarketplaceorderid)]|false|none|
|» marketplaceTechnicalCodes|body|[[BeezUP.Common.MarketplaceTechnicalCode](#schemabeezup.common.marketplacetechnicalcode)]|false|none|
|» orderMerchantInfoSynchronizationStatus|body|[orderMerchantInfoSynchronizationStatus](#schemaordermerchantinfosynchronizationstatus)|false|Indicates on which order merchant info synchronization status to filter|
|» order_Buyer_Name|body|[order_Buyer_Name](#schemaorder_buyer_name)|false|Buyer full name|
|» order_MerchantOrderIds|body|[[order_MerchantOrderId](#schemaorder_merchantorderid)]|false|Merchant order id list|
|» storeIds|body|[[BeezUP.Common.StoreId](#schemabeezup.common.storeid)]|false|Store Id list|
|» pageNumber|body|[pageNumber](#schemapagenumber)|true|Indicates the page number|
|» pageSize|body|[pageSize](#schemapagesize)|true|Indicate the order count per page|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» dateSearchType|Modification|
|» dateSearchType|Purchase|
|» dateSearchType|MarketPlaceModification|

<h3 id="get-a-paginated-list-of-all-orders-without-details-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[orderListRequest](#schemaorderlistrequest)|true|none|
|» accountIds|body|[[accountId](#schemaaccountid)]|false|Account Id list|
|» beezUPOrderStatuses|body|[[beezUPOrderStatus](#schemabeezuporderstatus)]|false|none|
|» beginPeriodUtcDate|body|string(date-time)|true|The begin period you want to make the search. \<br>The period MUST not be greater than 62 days.<br>The begin period MUST be lower than the end period.<br>|
|» dateSearchType|body|[dateSearchType](#schemadatesearchtype)|false|Indicates on which date you want to make the filter|
|» endPeriodUtcDate|body|string(date-time)|true|The end period of you search. \<br>The period MUST not be greater than 62 days. \<br>The end period MUST be greater than the begin period.<br>The end period MUST be lower to the current date.<br>|
|» invoiceAvailabilityType|body|[invoiceAvailabilityType](#schemainvoiceavailabilitytype)|false|Indicates on which invoice availability to filter|
|» marketplaceBusinessCodes|body|[[BeezUP.Common.MarketplaceBusinessCode](#schemabeezup.common.marketplacebusinesscode)]|false|none|
|» marketplaceOrderIds|body|[[marketplaceOrderId](#schemamarketplaceorderid)]|false|none|
|» marketplaceTechnicalCodes|body|[[BeezUP.Common.MarketplaceTechnicalCode](#schemabeezup.common.marketplacetechnicalcode)]|false|none|
|» orderMerchantInfoSynchronizationStatus|body|[orderMerchantInfoSynchronizationStatus](#schemaordermerchantinfosynchronizationstatus)|false|Indicates on which order merchant info synchronization status to filter|
|» order_Buyer_Name|body|[order_Buyer_Name](#schemaorder_buyer_name)|false|Buyer full name|
|» order_MerchantOrderIds|body|[[order_MerchantOrderId](#schemaorder_merchantorderid)]|false|Merchant order id list|
|» storeIds|body|[[BeezUP.Common.StoreId](#schemabeezup.common.storeid)]|false|Store Id list|
|» pageNumber|body|[pageNumber](#schemapagenumber)|true|Indicates the page number|
|» pageSize|body|[pageSize](#schemapagesize)|true|Indicate the order count per page|

## Send harvest request for an Account

<a id="opIdHarvestAccount"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/orders/v3/Amazon/1001/harvest \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`POST /orders/v3/{marketplaceTechnicalCode}/{accountId}/harvest`

<h3 id="send-harvest-request-for-an-account-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|marketplaceTechnicalCode|path|string|true|The marketplace technical code|
|accountId|path|integer(int32)|true|none|
|marketplaceOrderId|query|string|false|none|
|beezUPOrderId|query|string|false|none|

## Creates a subscription to the orders

<a id="opIdCreateSubscription"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/marketplaces/orders/subscriptions/string \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "merchantApplicationName": "MyApp",
    "merchantApplicationVersion": "1.0",
    "merchantEmailAlert": "paulsimon@mysupercompany.com",
    "name": "MySubscriptionName",
    "targetUrl": "http://www.mydomain.com"
  }'
```

`POST /v2/user/marketplaces/orders/subscriptions/{id}`

Please take a look at this sequence diagram to understand the subscription process to follow [here](https://www.websequencediagrams.com/files/render?link=SBYbeIc8NGshk6ooCbmjoBLIMl4fIGO1xjJbPBQAglBo0n6BwEReh7NXQiPSjOTX)

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "merchantApplicationName": "MyApp",
  "merchantApplicationVersion": "1.0",
  "merchantEmailAlert": "paulsimon@mysupercompany.com",
  "name": "MySubscriptionName",
  "targetUrl": "http://www.mydomain.com"
}
```

<h3 id="creates-a-subscription-to-the-orders-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string(SubscriptionId)|true|none|
|body|body|[createSubscriptionRequest](#schemacreatesubscriptionrequest)|true|none|
|» merchantApplicationName|body|[subscriptionMerchantApplicationName](#schemasubscriptionmerchantapplicationname)|true|The name of your application|
|» merchantApplicationVersion|body|[subscriptionMerchantApplicationVersion](#schemasubscriptionmerchantapplicationversion)|true|The version of your application|
|» merchantEmailAlert|body|[email](#schemaemail)|false|The email|
|» name|body|[subscriptionName](#schemasubscriptionname)|true|The subscription name you want to use|
|» targetUrl|body|[httpUrl](#schemahttpurl)|true|The URL <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/URL">https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/URL</a>|

## Activate a subscription to the orders

<a id="opIdActivateSubscription"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/marketplaces/orders/subscriptions/string/activate \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "recoverBeginPeriodOrderLastModificationUtcDate": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "recoverEndPeriodOrderLastModificationUtcDate": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  }'
```

`POST /v2/user/marketplaces/orders/subscriptions/{id}/activate`

At this moment, BeezUP will ensure that your callback url is respecting this specification: 
- https://app.swaggerhub.com/apis/BeezUP/public_marketplaces_orders_subscriptions_consumer-dev/1.0#/Subscriptions/Verification

After that we will send you the orders related to your subscription, respecting this specification: 
- https://app.swaggerhub.com/apis/BeezUP/public_marketplaces_orders_subscriptions_consumer-dev/1.0#/Subscriptions/PushOrders


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "recoverBeginPeriodOrderLastModificationUtcDate": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "recoverEndPeriodOrderLastModificationUtcDate": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

<h3 id="activate-a-subscription-to-the-orders-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string(SubscriptionId)|true|none|
|body|body|[activateSubscriptionRequest](#schemaactivatesubscriptionrequest)|false|none|
|» recoverBeginPeriodOrderLastModificationUtcDate|body|string(date-time)|false|If set, the date must be in the past the subscription will recover existing orders using the begin period order last modification date. If not set then you will receive new/updated orders in real-time.|
|» recoverEndPeriodOrderLastModificationUtcDate|body|string(date-time)|false|If end period set, first the date must be in the past, the subscription will recover existing orders using the begin and the end period order last modification date. <br>If end period is not set and the begin period is set, then you will recover existing orders from the past using the begin period last modification date and after than you will continue to receive new/updated orders in real-time.<br>If begin/end period are not set then you will receive new/updated orders in real-time.<br>REMARK: The begin period is required if the end period is fulfilled.<br>REMARK: If the end period is order last modification date is indicated then once we have push all orders to your target url the subscription will be desactivated.|

|---|---|---|---|
|202|Accepted|Retry push orders request accepted|None|
|404|Not Found|The subscription is not found|[errorResponseMessage](#schemaerrorresponsemessage)|
|409|Conflict|The subscription is deactivated or your subscription consumption availability status is available.|[errorResponseMessage](#schemaerrorresponsemessage)|
|default|Default|Occurs when something goes wrong|[BeezUP.Common.ErrorResponseMessage](#schemabeezup.common.errorresponsemessage)|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

<h3 id="get-the-analytics-api-operation-index-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Analytics API operation index|[analyticsIndex](#schemaanalyticsindex)|
|default|Default|Occurs when something goes wrong|[BeezUP.Common.ErrorResponseMessage](#schemabeezup.common.errorresponsemessage)|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Get the Analytics API operation index for one store

<a id="opIdAnalyticsStoreIndex"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/analytics/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /v2/user/analytics/{storeId}`

<h3 id="get-the-analytics-api-operation-index-for-one-store-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|storeId|path|string(guid)|true|Your store identifier|

## Get the report by category

<a id="opIdGetStoreReportByCategory"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/analytics/string/reports/bycategory \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "advancedFilters": {
      "globalMarginPercent": "10",
      "linkClickToOrderMaxDay": "5",
      "linkClickToOrderType": "OnClickDate",
      "marginType": "Global",
      "onlyDirectSales": "true",
      "onlyPaymentValidatedOrders": "true",
      "performanceIndicatorFormula": {
        "firstParameter": "Cost",
        "operatorName": "Multiply",
        "secondParamter": "ROI",
        "thirdParameter": "100"
      }
    },
    "beginPeriodUtcDate": "2006-11-20T00:00:00Z",
    "categoryFilter": {
      "categoryPath": [
        "Maison",
        "Chambre"
      ]
    },
    "channelId": "2dc136a7-0d3d-4cc9-a825-a28a42c53e28",
    "endPeriodUtcDate": "2006-12-20T00:00:00Z",
    "performanceIndicatorFilters": [
      {
        "indicator": "Cost",
        "operatorName": "Equals",
        "value": "10"
      }
    ],
    "periodType": "Custom",
    "orderBy": "Cost",
    "orderByDirection": "Ascending",
    "pageNumber": "1",
    "pageSize": "100"
  }'
```

<h3 id="get-the-report-by-category-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|storeId|path|string(guid)|true|Your store identifier|
|body|body|[reportByCategoryRequest](#schemareportbycategoryrequest)|true|none|
|» advancedFilters|body|[reportAdvancedFilters](#schemareportadvancedfilters)|true|none|
|» beginPeriodUtcDate|body|string(date-time)|false|The begin date period you want to get the report. It's required only in case of custom period type !|
|» categoryFilter|body|[BeezUP.Common.CatalogCategoryFilter](#schemabeezup.common.catalogcategoryfilter)|false|none|
|» channelId|body|[BeezUP.Common.ChannelId](#schemabeezup.common.channelid)|false|The channel identifier|
|» endPeriodUtcDate|body|string(date-time)|false|The end date period you want to get the report. It's required only in case of custom period type !|
|» performanceIndicatorFilters|body|[[performanceIndicatorFilter](#schemaperformanceindicatorfilter)]|false|none|
|» periodType|body|[reportFilterPeriodType](#schemareportfilterperiodtype)|true|Indicates the period type we want use for the report filter|
|» orderBy|body|[performanceIndicatorType](#schemaperformanceindicatortype)|false|Indicate on which indicator or value you want to make your formula|
|» orderByDirection|body|[orderByDirection](#schemaorderbydirection)|false|Indicate which direction to order results by|
|» pageNumber|body|[BeezUP.Common.PageNumber](#schemabeezup.common.pagenumber)|false|Indicates the page number|
|» pageSize|body|[BeezUP.Common.PageSize](#schemabeezup.common.pagesize)|false|Indicate the item count per page|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» periodType|Custom|
|» periodType|Yesterday|
|» periodType|Last7Days|
|» periodType|LastWeek|
|» periodType|ThisMonth|
|» periodType|Last30Days|
|» periodType|LastMonth|
|» periodType|Last60Days|
|» periodType|Last90Days|
|» periodType|Last3Months|
|» orderBy|ClickCount|
|» orderBy|Cost|
|» orderBy|OrderCount|
|» orderBy|ProductCount|
|» orderBy|SoldProductCount|
|» orderBy|DisabledProductCount|
|» orderBy|EnabledProductCount|
|» orderBy|TotalSales|
|» orderBy|Margin|
|» orderBy|ROI|
|» orderBy|PerformanceIndicator|
|» orderByDirection|Ascending|
|» orderByDirection|Descending|

## Get the report by channel

<a id="opIdGetStoreReportByChannel"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/analytics/string/reports/bychannel \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "advancedFilters": {
      "globalMarginPercent": "10",
      "linkClickToOrderMaxDay": "5",
      "linkClickToOrderType": "OnClickDate",
      "marginType": "Global",
      "onlyDirectSales": "true",
      "onlyPaymentValidatedOrders": "true",
      "performanceIndicatorFormula": {
        "firstParameter": "Cost",
        "operatorName": "Multiply",
        "secondParamter": "ROI",
        "thirdParameter": "100"
      }
    },
    "beginPeriodUtcDate": "2006-11-20T00:00:00Z",
    "categoryFilter": {
      "categoryPath": [
        "Maison",
        "Chambre"
      ]
    },
    "channelId": "2dc136a7-0d3d-4cc9-a825-a28a42c53e28",
    "endPeriodUtcDate": "2006-12-20T00:00:00Z",
    "performanceIndicatorFilters": [
      {
        "indicator": "Cost",
        "operatorName": "Equals",
        "value": "10"
      }
    ],
    "periodType": "Custom",
    "orderBy": "Cost",
    "orderByDirection": "Ascending",
    "pageNumber": "1",
    "pageSize": "100"
  }'
```
