<h3 id="get-the-report-by-channel-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|storeId|path|string(guid)|true|Your store identifier|
|body|body|[reportByChannelRequest](#schemareportbychannelrequest)|true|none|
|» advancedFilters|body|[reportAdvancedFilters](#schemareportadvancedfilters)|true|none|
|» beginPeriodUtcDate|body|string(date-time)|false|The begin date period you want to get the report. It's required only in case of custom period type !|
|» categoryFilter|body|[BeezUP.Common.CatalogCategoryFilter](#schemabeezup.common.catalogcategoryfilter)|false|none|
|» channelId|body|[BeezUP.Common.ChannelId](#schemabeezup.common.channelid)|false|The channel identifier|
|» endPeriodUtcDate|body|string(date-time)|false|The end date period you want to get the report. It's required only in case of custom period type !|
|» performanceIndicatorFilters|body|[[performanceIndicatorFilter](#schemaperformanceindicatorfilter)]|false|none|
|» periodType|body|[reportFilterPeriodType](#schemareportfilterperiodtype)|true|Indicates the period type we want use for the report filter|
|» orderBy|body|[performanceIndicatorType](#schemaperformanceindicatortype)|false|Indicate on which indicator or value you want to make your formula|
|» orderByDirection|body|[orderByDirection](#schemaorderbydirection)|false|Indicate which direction to order results by|
|» pageNumber|body|[BeezUP.Common.PageNumber](#schemabeezup.common.pagenumber)|false|Indicates the page number|
|» pageSize|body|[BeezUP.Common.PageSize](#schemabeezup.common.pagesize)|false|Indicate the item count per page|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» periodType|Custom|
|» periodType|Yesterday|
|» periodType|Last7Days|
|» periodType|LastWeek|
|» periodType|ThisMonth|
|» periodType|Last30Days|
|» periodType|LastMonth|
|» periodType|Last60Days|

|» orderBy|OrderCount|

|» orderBy|TotalSales|
|» orderBy|Margin|
|» orderBy|ROI|
|» orderBy|PerformanceIndicator|
|» orderByDirection|Ascending|
|» orderByDirection|Descending|

<h3 id="get-the-report-by-product-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|storeId|path|string(guid)|true|Your store identifier|
|body|body|[reportByProductRequest](#schemareportbyproductrequest)|true|none|
|» advancedFilters|body|[reportAdvancedFilters](#schemareportadvancedfilters)|true|none|
|» beginPeriodUtcDate|body|string(date-time)|true|The begin date period you want to get the report. It's required only in case of custom period type !|
|» categoryFilter|body|[BeezUP.Common.CatalogCategoryFilter](#schemabeezup.common.catalogcategoryfilter)|false|none|
|» channelId|body|[BeezUP.Common.ChannelId](#schemabeezup.common.channelid)|false|The channel identifier|
|» endPeriodUtcDate|body|string(date-time)|true|The end date period you want to get the report. It's required only in case of custom period type !|
|» performanceIndicatorFilters|body|[[performanceIndicatorFilter](#schemaperformanceindicatorfilter)]|false|none|
|» periodType|body|[reportFilterPeriodType](#schemareportfilterperiodtype)|true|Indicates the period type we want use for the report filter|
|» orderBy|body|[performanceIndicatorType](#schemaperformanceindicatortype)|false|Indicate on which indicator or value you want to make your formula|
|» orderByDirection|body|[orderByDirection](#schemaorderbydirection)|false|Indicate which direction to order results by|
|» pageNumber|body|[BeezUP.Common.PageNumber](#schemabeezup.common.pagenumber)|false|Indicates the page number|
|» pageSize|body|[BeezUP.Common.PageSize](#schemabeezup.common.pagesize)|false|Indicate the item count per page|
|» analyticsProductColumnFilters|body|[analyticsProductColumnFilters](#schemaanalyticsproductcolumnfilters)|false|none|
|» productColumnsToDisplay|body|[productColumnsToDisplay](#schemaproductcolumnstodisplay)|false|none|
|» productState|body|[productStateFilter](#schemaproductstatefilter)|true|You can filter on the product state.|

## Optimise all products

<a id="opIdOptimiseAll"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/analytics/string/optimisations/all/reenable \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "advancedFilters": {
      "globalMarginPercent": "10",
      "linkClickToOrderMaxDay": "5",
      "linkClickToOrderType": "OnClickDate",
      "marginType": "Global",
      "onlyDirectSales": "true",
      "onlyPaymentValidatedOrders": "true",
      "performanceIndicatorFormula": {
        "firstParameter": "Cost",
        "operatorName": "Multiply",
        "secondParamter": "ROI",
        "thirdParameter": "100"
      }
    },
    "beginPeriodUtcDate": "2006-11-20T00:00:00Z",
    "categoryFilter": {
      "categoryPath": [
        "Maison",
        "Chambre"
      ]
    },
    "channelId": "2dc136a7-0d3d-4cc9-a825-a28a42c53e28",
    "endPeriodUtcDate": "2006-12-20T00:00:00Z",
    "performanceIndicatorFilters": [
      {
        "indicator": "Cost",
        "operatorName": "Equals",
        "value": "10"
      }
    ],
    "periodType": "Custom",
    "orderBy": "Cost",
    "orderByDirection": "Ascending",
    "analyticsProductColumnFilters": {
      "additionalAnalyticsProductColumnFilters": {
        "property1": {
          "672644c7-5bd0-4e25-88c1-1f732bda5e4c": {
            "operatorName": "NumericalGreaterThan",
            "values": [
              "100"
            ]
          }
        },
        "property2": {
          "672644c7-5bd0-4e25-88c1-1f732bda5e4c": {
            "operatorName": "NumericalGreaterThan",
            "values": [
              "100"
            ]
          }
        }
      },
      "sku": "M1234",
      "title": "Refrigérateur"
    },
    "productColumnsToDisplay": [
      "4b460e31-3d1f-4117-922d-b159a64ec1d2"
    ],
    "productState": "All",
    "reportType": "ByProduct"
  }'
```

`POST /v2/user/analytics/{storeId}/optimisations/all/{actionName}`

/!\ WARNING /!\ \
Apply the operation on every product related to this request. \
This operation is used at the bottom of the analytics page result.

<h3 id="optimise-all-products-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|storeId|path|string(guid)|true|Your store identifier|
|actionName|path|string(optimisationActionName)|true|none|
|body|body|[optimiseAllRequest](#schemaoptimiseallrequest)|true|none|
|» advancedFilters|body|[reportAdvancedFilters](#schemareportadvancedfilters)|true|none|
|» beginPeriodUtcDate|body|string(date-time)|true|The begin date period you want to get the report. It's required only in case of custom period type !|
|» categoryFilter|body|[BeezUP.Common.CatalogCategoryFilter](#schemabeezup.common.catalogcategoryfilter)|false|none|
|» channelId|body|[BeezUP.Common.ChannelId](#schemabeezup.common.channelid)|false|The channel identifier|
|» endPeriodUtcDate|body|string(date-time)|true|The end date period you want to get the report. It's required only in case of custom period type !|
|» performanceIndicatorFilters|body|[[performanceIndicatorFilter](#schemaperformanceindicatorfilter)]|false|none|
|» periodType|body|[reportFilterPeriodType](#schemareportfilterperiodtype)|true|Indicates the period type we want use for the report filter|
|» orderBy|body|[performanceIndicatorType](#schemaperformanceindicatortype)|false|Indicate on which indicator or value you want to make your formula|
|» orderByDirection|body|[orderByDirection](#schemaorderbydirection)|false|Indicate which direction to order results by|
|» analyticsProductColumnFilters|body|[analyticsProductColumnFilters](#schemaanalyticsproductcolumnfilters)|false|none|
|» productColumnsToDisplay|body|[productColumnsToDisplay](#schemaproductcolumnstodisplay)|false|none|
|» productState|body|[productStateFilter](#schemaproductstatefilter)|false|You can filter on the product state.|
|» reportType|body|[reportType](#schemareporttype)|true|The report type|

## Optimise products by channel

<a id="opIdOptimiseByChannel"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/analytics/string/optimisations/bychannel/string/reenable \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`POST /v2/user/analytics/{storeId}/optimisations/bychannel/{channelId}/{actionName}`

## Rule creation

<a id="opIdCreateRule"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/analytics/string/rules \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "endUtcDate": "2017-09-30T10:42:40.001Z",
    "optimisationActionName": "reenable",
    "reportFilterId": "fb19c53c-2f63-4262-9d94-2d7faa500acd",
    "ruleName": "My rule",
    "startUtcDate": "2016-08-29T09:12:33.001Z"
  }'
```

`POST /v2/user/analytics/{storeId}/rules`

> Body parameter

```json
{
```

## View a preview an Order Invoice

<a id="opIdGetOrderInvoicePreview"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/v2/user/marketplaces/orders/invoices/string/string/string/preview \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept-Encoding: string' \
  -d '{
    "invoiceSequenceNumber": "879"
  }'
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|commercialOwnerEmail|[BeezUP.Common.Email](#schemabeezup.common.email)|false|none|The email|
|companyInfo|[companyInfo](#schemacompanyinfo)|false|none|none|
|email|[BeezUP.Common.Email](#schemabeezup.common.email)|true|none|The email|
|info|[BeezUP.Common.InfoSummaries](#schemabeezup.common.infosummaries)|false|none|none|
|links|[accountInfoLinks](#schemaaccountinfolinks)|true|none|The different actions you can make on this account|
|personalInfo|[personalInfo](#schemapersonalinfo)|false|none|none|
|profilePictureUrl|[profilePictureUrl](#schemaprofilepictureurl)|false|none|Indicate the url of your picture profil|
|status|[accountStatus](#schemaaccountstatus)|true|none|The account status<br>* Active:  When the account is active<br>* SystemBlocked:  When all stores on the account are blocked by the system<br>* UserBlocked: When all stores on the account are blocked on GO not on the system<br>* NotActivated: When the email is not verified<br>|
|userId|[BeezUP.Common.UserId](#schemabeezup.common.userid)|true|none|The user identifier|

|Property|Value|
|---|---|

<a id="schema_accountStatus"></a>
<a id="tocSaccountstatus"></a>
<a id="tocsaccountstatus"></a>

```json
"Active"
```

The account status
* Active:  When the account is active
* SystemBlocked:  When all stores on the account are blocked by the system
* UserBlocked: When all stores on the account are blocked on GO not on the system
* NotActivated: When the email is not verified

```json
  "recoverBeginPeriodOrderLastModificationUtcDate": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "recoverEndPeriodOrderLastModificationUtcDate": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|recoverBeginPeriodOrderLastModificationUtcDate|string(date-time)|false|none|If set, the date must be in the past the subscription will recover existing orders using the begin period order last modification date. If not set then you will receive new/updated orders in real-time.|
|recoverEndPeriodOrderLastModificationUtcDate|string(date-time)|false|none|If end period set, first the date must be in the past, the subscription will recover existing orders using the begin and the end period order last modification date. <br>If end period is not set and the begin period is set, then you will recover existing orders from the past using the begin period last modification date and after than you will continue to receive new/updated orders in real-time.<br>If begin/end period are not set then you will receive new/updated orders in real-time.<br>REMARK: The begin period is required if the end period is fulfilled.<br>REMARK: If the end period is order last modification date is indicated then once we have push all orders to your target url the subscription will be desactivated.|

<h2 id="tocS_autoImportConfiguration">autoImportConfiguration</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaautoimportconfiguration"></a>
<a id="schema_autoImportConfiguration"></a>
<a id="tocSautoimportconfiguration"></a>
<a id="tocsautoimportconfiguration"></a>

```json
{
  "duplicateProductConfiguration": {
    "compareOptions": "IgnoreCase",
    "strategy": "KeepFirstDuplicateProductOnly"
  },
  "input": {
    "files": [
      {
        "fetch": {
          "compressedRelativePath": "folder/file.xxx",
          "compressionFormatStrategy": "None",
          "credential": {
            "password": "MyPassword",
            "userName": "MyLogin"
          },
          "downloadCatalogStrategy": "SimpleUri",
          "downloadTimeout": "360",
          "uri": "http://www.mywebsite.com/mycatalog.csv"
        },
        "fileNumber": "1",
        "read": {
          "csvFileReadProperties": {
            "csvSeparator": ";",
            "csvTextQualifier": "\"",
            "hasHeaderRecord": "true",
            "ignoreHeaderRecord": "true"
          },
          "cultureName": "fr-FR",
          "encodingTypeName": "UTF-8",
          "format": "Csv",
          "xmlFileReadProperties": {
            "flattenXmlChildElements": "true",
            "useXmlAttributes": "true"
          }
        }
      }
    ],
    "transformFileUrl": "http://beezupblob.com/Mytransformation.xslt"
  },
  "inputConfiguredByUserId": "8a7fbdec-9e71-472e-9974-27d5c1d57cf8",
  "pauseStatusChangedByUserId": "8a7fbdec-9e71-472e-9974-27d5c1d57cf8",
  "pauseStatusChangedUtcDate": "2017-04-01T13:21:42Z",
  "paused": "false",
  "scheduledByUserId": "8a7fbdec-9e71-472e-9974-27d5c1d57cf8",
  "schedulingLocalTimeZoneName": "Romance Standard Time",
  "schedulingType": "Schedule",
  "schedulingValue": [
    "21:00:00",
    "23:00:00",
    "08:30:00"
  ]
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|duplicateProductConfiguration|[duplicateProductValueConfiguration](#schemaduplicateproductvalueconfiguration)|true|none|Describe how you want to manage the duplication of the product value|
|input|[inputConfiguration](#schemainputconfiguration)|true|none|Describe the input configuration|
|inputConfiguredByUserId|[BeezUP.Common.UserId](#schemabeezup.common.userid)|true|none|The user identifier|
|pauseStatusChangedByUserId|[BeezUP.Common.UserId](#schemabeezup.common.userid)|false|none|The user identifier|
|pauseStatusChangedUtcDate|string(date-time)|false|none|Indicate when the pause status has changed in UTC date.|
|paused|boolean|true|none|Indicate if the auto import is in pause or not.|
|scheduledByUserId|[BeezUP.Common.UserId](#schemabeezup.common.userid)|false|none|The user identifier|
|schedulingLocalTimeZoneName|string|false|none|Indicate the time zone name of the scheduling. If the scheduling type is "Schedule"|
|schedulingType|[schedulingType](#schemaschedulingtype)|true|none|Indicate the scheduling type. Schedule or Interval. We recommand you to use interval for a better reporting.|
|schedulingValue|[string]|true|none|Indicate the scheduling value. If the scheduling type is Interval then the value will be a duration otherwise the values will be the time.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|schedulingType|Schedule|
|schedulingType|Interval|

Describe a BeezUP column

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|beezUPColumnName|[BeezUP.Common.BeezUPColumnName](#schemabeezup.common.beezupcolumnname)|true|none|The BeezUP column name|
|canBeTruncated|[canBeTruncated](#schemacanbetruncated)|false|none|If the size of the value is greater than the limit we can truncate the value instead of failing...|
|columnDataType|[BeezUP.Common.ColumnDataType](#schemabeezup.common.columndatatype)|false|none|Data type of the column, will be used for parsing and for consolidation proces|
|columnImportance|[BeezUP.Common.ColumnImportance](#schemabeezup.common.columnimportance)|true|none|Importance of the column|
|description|string|false|none|Describe the BeezUP column|
|displayGroupName|[displayGroupName](#schemadisplaygroupname)|true|none|Indicate the display group name where the column must be putted|
|unique|boolean|false|none|/!\ ONLY AVAILABLE ON CATALOG COLUMN NOT ON CUSTOM COLUMNS!!<br>If true, an error happen at the second occurence of the same value for this column<br>This information will be used during the importation process and later for mapping proposal|

|columnImportance|Optional|

<h2 id="tocS_catalogStoreStatus">catalogStoreStatus</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacatalogstorestatus"></a>
<a id="schema_catalogStoreStatus"></a>
<a id="tocScatalogstorestatus"></a>
<a id="tocscatalogstorestatus"></a>

```json
"OK"
```

Indicates the status of the catalog store.
* OK: If the latest importation is a success!
* Failed: If the latest importation has failed !
* Outdated: If the latest succeed importation is later than 1 day.

<h2 id="tocS_channelCatalogCategoryConfiguration">channelCatalogCategoryConfiguration</h2>

```json
  "autoMapNewSubCategories": "true",
  "catalogCategoryPath": [
    "Vêtements",
    "Femmes",
    "Chaussures"
  ],

    "Clothing",
    "Women",
    "Shoes"
  ],
  "costValue": "10.21"

```

Represent a mapping between a catalog category path and a channel category path.
The cost on this mapping can be applied.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|autoMapNewSubCategories|boolean|true|none|Great feature! In case of mapping to parent catalog category, you can ask to automatically map new sub catalog category in the next importation to this channel category path.|
|catalogCategoryPath|[BeezUP.Common.CatalogCategoryPath](#schemabeezup.common.catalogcategorypath)|true|none|The catalog category path|
|channelCategoryPath|[BeezUP.Common.ChannelCategoryPath](#schemabeezup.common.channelcategorypath)|false|none|The channel category path|
|costValue|[channelCatalogCategoryCostValue](#schemachannelcatalogcategorycostvalue)|false|none|In case of CPC_ByCategory or CPA_ByCategory cost type, you have to indicate the cost value.|

Indicates the actions you can do on a channel catalog

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|categoryMappings|[links.GetChannelCatalogCategoriesLink](#schemalinks.getchannelcatalogcategorieslink)|false|none|none|
|channelInfo|[externalLinks.GetChannelInfoLink](#schemaexternallinks.getchannelinfolink)|false|none|none|

|configureCostSettings|[links.ConfigureChannelCatalogCostSettingsLink](#schemalinks.configurechannelcatalogcostsettingslink)|false|none|none|
|configureGeneralSettings|[links.ConfigureChannelCatalogGeneralSettingsLink](#schemalinks.configurechannelcataloggeneralsettingslink)|false|none|none|
|delete|[links.DeleteChannelCatalogLink](#schemalinks.deletechannelcataloglink)|false|none|none|
|disable|[links.DisableChannelCatalogLink](#schemalinks.disablechannelcataloglink)|false|none|none|

|enable|[links.EnableChannelCatalogLink](#schemalinks.enablechannelcataloglink)|false|none|none|
|exclusionFilters|[links.GetChannelCatalogExclusionFiltersLink](#schemalinks.getchannelcatalogexclusionfilterslink)|false|none|none|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|disabledProductCountExcludingUncategorized|integer(int32)|false|none|Disabled product count EXCLUDING uncategorized products on existing products.|
|disabledProductCountIncludingUncategorized|integer(int32)|false|none|Disabled product count INCLUDING uncategorized products on existing products.|
|excludedProductCountExcludingUncategorizedAndDisabled|integer(int32)|false|none|Excluded product count EXCLUDING uncategorized products AND disabled products on existing products.|
|excludedProductCountIncludingUncategorizedAndDisabled|integer(int32)|false|none|Excluded product count INCLUDING uncategorized products AND disabled products on existing products.|
|existingProductCount|integer(int32)|false|none|Imported product count currently in your catalog.|
|uncategorizedProductCount|integer(int32)|false|none|Product count WITHOUT category mapped on existing products.|

Indicates the configuration applied on the column (catalog or custom) during the importation process.

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|canBeTruncated|[canBeTruncated](#schemacanbetruncated)|false|none|If the size of the value is greater than the limit we can truncate the value instead of failing...|
|columnCultureName|[columnCultureName](#schemacolumnculturename)|false|none|If non null, culture used to parse the value to the storage type of this column\r\n will be used for parsing and for consolidation proces|
|columnDataType|[BeezUP.Common.ColumnDataType](#schemabeezup.common.columndatatype)|true|none|Data type of the column, will be used for parsing and for consolidation proces|
|columnFormat|[columnFormat](#schemacolumnformat)|false|none|If non null, format used to parse the value to the storage type of this column\r\n will be used for parsing and for consolidation proces|
|columnImportance|[BeezUP.Common.ColumnImportance](#schemabeezup.common.columnimportance)|true|none|Importance of the column|
|displayGroupName|[displayGroupName](#schemadisplaygroupname)|false|none|Indicate the display group name where the column must be putted|

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|columnDataType|String|
|columnDataType|Url|
|columnDataType|Text|
|columnDataType|Decimal|
|columnDataType|DateTime|
|columnDataType|Int|
|columnDataType|SpecialInt|
|columnDataType|InStock|
|columnDataType|Unknown|
|columnDataType|ImageUrl|
|columnImportance|Required|
|columnImportance|Recommended|
|columnImportance|Optional|

<h2 id="tocS_costSettings">costSettings</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacostsettings"></a>
<a id="schema_costSettings"></a>
<a id="tocScostsettings"></a>
<a id="tocscostsettings"></a>

```json
{
  "costType": "Fixed_Global",
  "globalCostValue": "10.21"
}
```

If this property is not indicated please force the user to configure the cost settings.
Defines the cost type you have on this channel with the cost value.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|costType|[costType](#schemacosttype)|true|none|CPC means cost per click.<br>CPA means cost per action.<br>You can have CPC/CPA with a global cost value.<br>You can have CPC/CPA by category the cost value MUST be null<br>You can have global fixed price.<br>|
|globalCostValue|number(decimal)|false|none|In case of global cost type, you have to indicate the cost value.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|costType|CPC_Global|
|costType|CPA_Global|
|costType|CPC_ByCategory|
|costType|CPA_ByCategory|
|costType|Fixed_Global|

You can have global fixed price.

The custom column configuration

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|catalogColumnDependencies|[[catalogColumnName](#schemacatalogcolumnname)]|false|none|none|
|configuration|[columnConfiguration](#schemacolumnconfiguration)|true|none|Indicates the configuration applied on the column (catalog or custom) during the importation process.|
|id|[columnId](#schemacolumnid)|true|none|The catalog column identifier|
|links|[customColumnLinks](#schemacustomcolumnlinks)|true|none|none|
|userColumName|[userColumName](#schemausercolumname)|true|none|Column named by the user|

Describe how you want to manage the duplication of the product value

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|compareOptions|[compareOptions](#schemacompareoptions)|true|none|Indicate how the product sku are compared for the duplication check.|
|strategy|[duplicateProductValueStrategy](#schemaduplicateproductvaluestrategy)|true|none|Indicate the duplicate product sku strategy.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|compareOptions|None|
|compareOptions|IgnoreCase|
|compareOptions|IgnoreNonSpace|
|compareOptions|IgnoreSymbols|
|compareOptions|OrdinalIgnoreCase|
|compareOptions|StringSort|
|compareOptions|Ordinal|
|strategy|None|

Describe the reporting of the catalog importation

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|beginUtcDate|string(date-time)|true|none|The start date of the importation|
|errors|[[BeezUP.Common.UserErrorMessage](#schemabeezup.common.usererrormessage)]|false|none|In case of error a description will be indicated|
|executionId|[executionId](#schemaexecutionid)|true|none|The execution identifier of the catalog importation|
|lastUpdateUtcDate|string(date-time)|true|none|The last update of the reporting|
|links|[importationMonitoringLinks](#schemaimportationmonitoringlinks)|false|none|Applicable operations considering the state of the importation|
|steps|object|true|none|Contains all steps of the importation process with a boolean. If true the step has been passed, false the step is not complete|
|success|boolean|true|none|Indicates if the importation was successfully completed or not|
|userId|[BeezUP.Common.UserId](#schemabeezup.common.userid)|false|none|The user identifier|

The catalog importation reporting

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|autoImported|boolean|false|none|Indicate if this importation is an auto import or not.|
|beginUtcDate|string(date-time)|true|none|Indicate the begin UTC date of this importation.|
|endUtcDate|string(date-time)|false|none|Indicate the end UTC date of this importation.|
|errors|[[BeezUP.Common.UserErrorMessage](#schemabeezup.common.usererrormessage)]|false|none|Indicate the error message list related to this importation.|
|executionId|[executionId](#schemaexecutionid)|true|none|The execution identifier of the catalog importation|
|inputConfigurationUrl|string(uri)|false|none|Indicate the input url of this importation.|
|lastUpdateUtcDate|string(date-time)|true|none|Indicate the last update UTC date of the reporting.|
|links|[importationReportingLinks](#schemaimportationreportinglinks)|false|none|none|
|stepName|string|false|none|The last step name of the importation process|
|steps|object|true|none|Indicate the steps that have been passed during the importation process|
|success|boolean|false|none|Indicate if the importation succeed or not.|
|totalProductCount|integer(int32)|false|none|Indicate the total product count detected in the catalog during the importation.|
|totalProductErrorCount|integer(int32)|false|none|Indicate the total product count in error detected in the catalog during the importation.|
|totalProductSuccessCount|integer(int32)|false|none|Indicate the total product count in success in the catalog during the importation.|
|userId|[BeezUP.Common.UserId](#schemabeezup.common.userid)|false|none|The user identifier|

This object indicates you the association between a channel catalog and a marketplace. The account identifier will be automatically defined based on your marketplace merchant identfier.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|apiSettingsStatus|[BeezUP.Common.ApiSettingsStatus](#schemabeezup.common.apisettingsstatus)|true|none|none|
|beezUPChannelCatalogId|[BeezUP.Common.ChannelCatalogId](#schemabeezup.common.channelcatalogid)|true|none|The channel catalog identifier|
|beezUPChannelId|[BeezUP.Common.ChannelId](#schemabeezup.common.channelid)|true|none|The channel identifier|
|beezUPMarketplaceName|object|true|none|The marketplace name|
|beezUPStoreId|[BeezUP.Common.StoreId](#schemabeezup.common.storeid)|true|none|The store identifier|
|beezUPStoreName|string|true|none|The store name|
|enabled|boolean|true|none|The enabled status of the Channel Catalog|
|links|[marketplaceChannelCatalogLinks](#schemamarketplacechannelcataloglinks)|true|none|Indicate the actions you can do on a channel catalog. If the settings are valid, you will be able to access to the publication history.|
|lovLinks|[marketplaceChannelCatalogLovLinks](#schemamarketplacechannelcataloglovlinks)|true|none|Indicates the List Of Values related to the marketplace|
|marketplaceAccountId|[BeezUP.Common.MarketplaceAccountId](#schemabeezup.common.marketplaceaccountid)|false|none|The marketplace account identifier in BeezUP. This account identifier is based on your api settings.|
|marketplaceBusinessCode|[BeezUP.Common.MarketplaceBusinessCode](#schemabeezup.common.marketplacebusinesscode)|true|none|In an marketplace technical code like CDiscount you can have several marketplaces like GO SPORT, etc. We identify them by a business code.|
|marketplaceIsoCountryCodeAlpha2|string|true|none|The marketplace country iso code alpha 2 (see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2#Decoding_table for more details)|
|marketplaceMarketPlaceId|string|true|none|The marketplace identifier in the marketplace|
|marketplaceMerchantIdentifiers|object|false|none|The marketplace merchant identifier list|
|marketplaceTechnicalCode|[BeezUP.Common.MarketplaceTechnicalCode](#schemabeezup.common.marketplacetechnicalcode)|true|none|The technical code of the marketplace.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|apiSettingsStatus|warning|
|apiSettingsStatus|success|
|apiSettingsStatus|failed|

|settings|[links.GetChannelCatalogMarketplaceSettingsLink](#schemalinks.getchannelcatalogmarketplacesettingslink)|true|none|none|

Describe the basic information related to an order. All properties with the prefix order_ are translated in the list of values /user/lov/OrderMetaInfoOrderDetails

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|[accountId](#schemaaccountid)|true|none|The marketplace account identifier in BeezUP. This account identifier is based on your api settings.|
|beezUPOrderId|[beezUPOrderId](#schemabeezuporderid)|true|none|The BeezUP Order identifier|
|beezUPOrderUrl|[BeezUP.Common.HttpUrl](#schemabeezup.common.httpurl)|false|none|The URL <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/URL">https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/URL</a>|
|etag|[etag](#schemaetag)|true|none|ETag value to identify the order.\<br>This information is required for the operation GetOrder and ChangeOrder.\<br>For more details go to this link: http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7232#section-2.3<br>|
|links|[orderHeaderLinks](#schemaorderheaderlinks)|true|none|none|
|marketplaceBusinessCode|[BeezUP.Common.MarketplaceBusinessCode](#schemabeezup.common.marketplacebusinesscode)|true|none|In an marketplace technical code like CDiscount you can have several marketplaces like GO SPORT, etc. We identify them by a business code.|
|marketplaceTechnicalCode|[BeezUP.Common.MarketplaceTechnicalCode](#schemabeezup.common.marketplacetechnicalcode)|true|none|The technical code of the marketplace.|
|order_Buyer_Name|[order_Buyer_Name](#schemaorder_buyer_name)|false|none|Buyer full name|
|order_CurrencyCode|[BeezUP.Common.CurrencyCode](#schemabeezup.common.currencycode)|false|none|The currency code <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217">(ISO 4217)</a><br>|
|order_Invoice_Number|string|false|none|The order invoice number|
|order_Invoice_Uri|string|false|none|The order invoice URI|
|order_LastModificationUtcDate|string(date-time)|true|none|The last modification UTC date done by BeezUP of this order|
|order_MarketplaceLastModificationUtcDate|string(date-time)|true|none|The last modification UTC date done by the marketplace on this order|
|order_MarketplaceOrderId|[marketplaceOrderId](#schemamarketplaceorderid)|true|none|The order marketplace identifier|
|order_MerchantECommerceSoftwareName|[order_MerchantECommerceSoftwareName](#schemaorder_merchantecommercesoftwarename)|false|none|The e-commerce software name of the merchant|
|order_MerchantECommerceSoftwareVersion|[order_MerchantECommerceSoftwareVersion](#schemaorder_merchantecommercesoftwareversion)|false|none|The e-commece software version of the merchant|
|order_MerchantOrderId|[order_MerchantOrderId](#schemaorder_merchantorderid)|false|none|The order merchant identifier|
|order_PurchaseUtcDate|string(date-time)|true|none|The purchase date of this order|
|order_Status_BeezUPOrderStatus|[beezUPOrderStatus](#schemabeezuporderstatus)|true|none|BeezUP order status. Unified for all marketplaces.|
|order_Status_MarketplaceOrderStatus|[marketplaceOrderStatus](#schemamarketplaceorderstatus)|false|none|The marketplace order state|
|order_TotalPrice|number(decimal)|false|none|The total price of this order (corresponding to the amount paid by the customer)|
|processing|[processing](#schemaprocessing)|true|none|If true, there is currently a harvest or an order change in progress. Otherwise false.|

|order_CurrencyCode|[BeezUP.Common.CurrencyCode](#schemabeezup.common.currencycode)|false|none|The currency code <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217">(ISO 4217)</a><br>|

|order_Invoice_Uri|string|false|none|The order invoice URI|

|order_MarketplaceOrderId|[marketplaceOrderId](#schemamarketplaceorderid)|true|none|The order marketplace identifier|
|order_MerchantECommerceSoftwareName|[order_MerchantECommerceSoftwareName](#schemaorder_merchantecommercesoftwarename)|false|none|The e-commerce software name of the merchant|

|order_MerchantOrderId|[order_MerchantOrderId](#schemaorder_merchantorderid)|false|none|The order merchant identifier|
|order_PurchaseUtcDate|string(date-time)|true|none|The purchase date of this order|
|order_Status_BeezUPOrderStatus|[beezUPOrderStatus](#schemabeezuporderstatus)|true|none|BeezUP order status. Unified for all marketplaces.|
|order_Status_MarketplaceOrderStatus|[marketplaceOrderStatus](#schemamarketplaceorderstatus)|false|none|The marketplace order state|
|order_TotalPrice|number(decimal)|false|none|The total price of this order (corresponding to the amount paid by the customer)|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

|productVATPercent|[productVATPercent](#schemaproductvatpercent)|true|none|Product VAT in percent|
|shippingVATPercent|[shippingVATPercent](#schemashippingvatpercent)|true|none|Shipping cost VAT in percent|

<h2 id="tocS_orderItem">orderItem</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaorderitem"></a>
<a id="schema_orderItem"></a>
<a id="tocSorderitem"></a>
<a id="tocsorderitem"></a>

```json
{
  "beezUPOrderItemId": "1",
  "orderItem_BeezUPStoreId": "00000000-cceb-4c20-b2c9-000000000000",
  "orderItem_Condition": "New",
  "orderItem_ImageUrl": "http://blabla.com//das6-45.jpg",
  "orderItem_ItemPrice": "6.86",
  "orderItem_ItemTax": "0.0",
  "orderItem_MarketPlaceProductId": "",
  "orderItem_MarketplaceImageUri": "http://beezupblob.com/marketplaceImg.jpg",
  "orderItem_MarketplaceProductUri": "http://beezupblob.com/productLink.xml",
  "orderItem_MerchantImportedProductId": "73267",
  "orderItem_MerchantImportedProductIdColumnName": "reference",
  "orderItem_MerchantImportedProductUrl": "http://blabla.com/my-folder/73267.html",
  "orderItem_MerchantProductId": "BlaLdas6-4.5",
  "orderItem_MerchantProductIdColumnName": "reference_produit",
  "orderItem_OrderItemType": "Product",
  "orderItem_Quantity": "1.0",
  "orderItem_Shipping_Price": "0.0",
  "orderItem_Title": "bLA acide-plomb 6v-4.5ah 70x48x106mm",
  "orderItem_TotalPrice": "6.86",
  "orderItem_gtin": "gtin_sample"
}
```

Describe an order item. All properties with the prefix orderItem_ are translated in the list of values /user/lov/OrderMetaInfoOrderItems

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|beezUPOrderItemId|string|true|none|The BeezUP identifier of the order Item|
|orderItem_BeezUPStoreId|string|false|none|The store id in the beezup system related to the order item. This property will help you to match the order to the inventory system.|
|orderItem_Condition|string|false|none|The merchant product condition of the order item|
|orderItem_ImageUrl|string|false|none|The URL of the image of the order item|
|orderItem_ItemPrice|number(decimal)|false|none|The price of the order item|
|orderItem_ItemTax|number(decimal)|false|none|The tax of the order item|
|orderItem_MarketPlaceProductId|string|false|none|The marketplace product identifier of the order item|
|orderItem_MarketplaceImageUri|string|false|none|The marketplace image uri|
|orderItem_MarketplaceProductUri|string|false|none|The merchant product uri of the order item|
|orderItem_MerchantImportedProductId|string|false|none|The product id indicated in the catalog importation in BeezUP system for this order item. This property will help you to match the order to the inventory system.|
|orderItem_MerchantImportedProductIdColumnName|string|false|none|The column name for the product id indicated in the catalog importation in BeezUP system related to this order item. This property will help you to match the order to the inventory system.|
|orderItem_MerchantImportedProductUrl|string|false|none|The product url indicated in the catalog importation in BeezUP system related to this order item|
|orderItem_MerchantProductId|string|false|none|The merchant product id of the order item|
|orderItem_MerchantProductIdColumnName|string|false|none|The column name indicate in the mapping for the product id related to the order item|
|orderItem_OrderItemType|string|true|none|The order item type of the order item|
|orderItem_Quantity|number(decimal)|false|none|The quantity of the order item|
|orderItem_Shipping_Price|number(decimal)|false|none|The shipping price of the order item|
|orderItem_Title|string|false|none|The title of the order item|
|orderItem_TotalPrice|number(decimal)|false|none|The total price of the order item|
|orderItem_gtin|string|false|none|The order item gtin|

The order list with all information we have from the orders and its items.\
The paginationResult properties can be null if the list is empty.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|links|[orderListFullLinks](#schemaorderlistfulllinks)|true|none|none|
|orders|[[order](#schemaorder)]|true|none|none|
|paginationResult|[BeezUP.Common.PaginationResult](#schemabeezup.common.paginationresult)|false|none|none|

```json
{
  "advancedFilters": {
    "globalMarginPercent": "10",
    "linkClickToOrderMaxDay": "5",
    "linkClickToOrderType": "OnClickDate",
    "marginType": "Global",
    "onlyDirectSales": "true",
    "onlyPaymentValidatedOrders": "true",
    "performanceIndicatorFormula": {
      "firstParameter": "Cost",
      "operatorName": "Multiply",
      "secondParamter": "ROI",
      "thirdParameter": "100"
    }
  },
  "beginPeriodUtcDate": "2006-11-20T00:00:00Z",
  "categoryFilter": {
    "categoryPath": [
      "Maison",
      "Chambre"
    ]
  },
  "channelId": "2dc136a7-0d3d-4cc9-a825-a28a42c53e28",
  "endPeriodUtcDate": "2006-12-20T00:00:00Z",
  "performanceIndicatorFilters": [
    {
      "indicator": "Cost",
      "operatorName": "Equals",
      "value": "10"
    }
  ],
  "periodType": "Custom",
  "orderBy": "Cost",
  "orderByDirection": "Ascending"
}
```

Contains common filter parameters with Order By functionnality

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|advancedFilters|[reportAdvancedFilters](#schemareportadvancedfilters)|true|none|none|
|beginPeriodUtcDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The begin date period you want to get the report. It's required only in case of custom period type !|
|categoryFilter|[BeezUP.Common.CatalogCategoryFilter](#schemabeezup.common.catalogcategoryfilter)|false|none|none|
|channelId|[BeezUP.Common.ChannelId](#schemabeezup.common.channelid)|false|none|The channel identifier|
|endPeriodUtcDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The end date period you want to get the report. It's required only in case of custom period type !|
|performanceIndicatorFilters|[[performanceIndicatorFilter](#schemaperformanceindicatorfilter)]|false|none|none|
|periodType|[reportFilterPeriodType](#schemareportfilterperiodtype)|true|none|Indicates the period type we want use for the report filter|
|orderBy|[performanceIndicatorType](#schemaperformanceindicatortype)|false|none|Indicate on which indicator or value you want to make your formula|
|orderByDirection|[orderByDirection](#schemaorderbydirection)|false|none|Indicate which direction to order results by|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|periodType|Custom|
|periodType|Yesterday|
|periodType|Last7Days|
|periodType|LastWeek|
|periodType|ThisMonth|
|periodType|Last30Days|
|periodType|LastMonth|
|periodType|Last60Days|
|periodType|Last90Days|
|periodType|Last3Months|
|orderBy|ClickCount|
|orderBy|Cost|
|orderBy|OrderCount|
|orderBy|ProductCount|
|orderBy|SoldProductCount|
|orderBy|DisabledProductCount|
|orderBy|EnabledProductCount|
|orderBy|TotalSales|
|orderBy|Margin|
|orderBy|ROI|
|orderBy|PerformanceIndicator|
|orderByDirection|Ascending|
|orderByDirection|Descending|

<h2 id="tocS_productSetVisibilityCriteria">productSetVisibilityCriteria</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaproductsetvisibilitycriteria"></a>
<a id="schema_productSetVisibilityCriteria"></a>
<a id="tocSproductsetvisibilitycriteria"></a>
<a id="tocsproductsetvisibilitycriteria"></a>

```json
{
  "disabled": "false",
  "excluded": "false",
  "exist": "true",
  "logic": "funnel",
  "uncategorized": "false"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|disabled|boolean|false|none|Search disabled products. If null the filter will not be taken in account.|
|excluded|boolean|false|none|Search excluded products by at least an exclusion filter. If null the filter will not be taken in account.|
|exist|boolean|false|none|If false, search for products absent from the current catalog. If true, search for products currently in the catalog. If null the filter will not be taken in account.|
|logic|[productSetVisibilityCriteriaLogicType](#schemaproductsetvisibilitycriterialogictype)|true|none|Indicate how you want to combine the filters:<br>* funnel: You will get the products which meet at least one of the product set criterion. The criteria are applied in the following order:<br>  - categorization<br>  - exclusion filters<br>  - deactivations<br>* cumulative: You will get the products which have all the product set criteria<br>|
|uncategorized|boolean|false|none|Search product WITHOUT category mapped with the channel. If null the filter will not be taken in account.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|logic|funnel|
|logic|cumulative|

<h2 id="tocS_productSetVisibilityCriteriaLogicType">productSetVisibilityCriteriaLogicType</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaproductsetvisibilitycriterialogictype"></a>
<a id="schema_productSetVisibilityCriteriaLogicType"></a>
<a id="tocSproductsetvisibilitycriterialogictype"></a>
<a id="tocsproductsetvisibilitycriterialogictype"></a>

```json
"funnel"
```

Indicate how you want to combine the filters:
* funnel: You will get the products which meet at least one of the product set criterion. The criteria are applied in the following order:
  - categorization
  - exclusion filters
  - deactivations
* cumulative: You will get the products which have all the product set criteria

<h2 id="tocS_publicationStrategyKind">publicationStrategyKind</h2>

<a id="schemapublicationstrategykind"></a>

<a id="tocspublicationstrategykind"></a>

```json
"Delta"
```

Define the publication strategy kind, for that you have 2 choices 
* Delta - This is the recommanded publication strategy kind, this strategy will push to the marketplace only the difference between your catalog and the previous published feeds done by BeezUP. 
* Full - If you want to force the publication of all your catalog feeds to the marketplace. 
      !WARNING! Depending to the marketplace this operation will purge the existing offers on the marketplace that are not in the catalog or unknown from the publication feed referential.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|advancedFilters|[reportAdvancedFilters](#schemareportadvancedfilters)|true|none|none|
|beginPeriodUtcDate|string(date-time)|true|none|The begin date period you want to get the report. It's required only in case of custom period type !|
|categoryFilter|[BeezUP.Common.CatalogCategoryFilter](#schemabeezup.common.catalogcategoryfilter)|false|none|none|
|channelId|[BeezUP.Common.ChannelId](#schemabeezup.common.channelid)|false|none|The channel identifier|
|endPeriodUtcDate|string(date-time)|true|none|The end date period you want to get the report. It's required only in case of custom period type !|
|performanceIndicatorFilters|[[performanceIndicatorFilter](#schemaperformanceindicatorfilter)]|false|none|none|
|periodType|[reportFilterPeriodType](#schemareportfilterperiodtype)|true|none|Indicates the period type we want use for the report filter|
|orderBy|[performanceIndicatorType](#schemaperformanceindicatortype)|false|none|Indicate on which indicator or value you want to make your formula|
|orderByDirection|[orderByDirection](#schemaorderbydirection)|false|none|Indicate which direction to order results by|
|pageNumber|[BeezUP.Common.PageNumber](#schemabeezup.common.pagenumber)|false|none|Indicates the page number|
|pageSize|[BeezUP.Common.PageSize](#schemabeezup.common.pagesize)|false|none|Indicate the item count per page|
|analyticsProductColumnFilters|[analyticsProductColumnFilters](#schemaanalyticsproductcolumnfilters)|false|none|none|
|productColumnsToDisplay|[productColumnsToDisplay](#schemaproductcolumnstodisplay)|false|none|none|
|productState|[productStateFilter](#schemaproductstatefilter)|true|none|You can filter on the product state.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|countryIsoCodeAlpha3|[storeCountryIsoCodeAlpha3](#schemastorecountryisocodealpha3)|true|none|The country iso code alpha 3 based on the list of values /user/lov/StoreCountry|
|creationUtcDate|string(date-time)|true|none|The creation date of the store|
|currencyCode|[BeezUP.Common.CurrencyCode](#schemabeezup.common.currencycode)|true|none|The currency code <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217">(ISO 4217)</a><br>|
|goVersion|integer(int32)|true|none|The version of GO to use|
|isTest|boolean|true|none|Is the store a test or a production store|
|links|[storeLinks](#schemastorelinks)|true|none|The action links for this store|
|name|[storeName](#schemastorename)|true|none|The store name. Must be unique.|
|offerId|[offerId](#schemaofferid)|true|none|The offer id based on /offers. Not a free offer of course.|
|offerName|string|true|none|The offer Name|
|ownerUserId|string(guid)|true|none|The user id of the owner of the store|
|sectors|[storeSectors](#schemastoresectors)|true|none|The store's sectors based on the list of values /user/lov/ParamSector|
|shareCount|integer|true|none|The share count related to this store|
|status|[storeStatus](#schemastorestatus)|true|none|The store status<br>* Active:  When the store is active<br>* SystemBlocked:  When the store is blocked by the system<br>* UserBlocked: When the store is blocked on GO not on the system<br>|
|storeId|[BeezUP.Common.StoreId](#schemabeezup.common.storeid)|true|none|The store identifier|
|url|[storeUrl](#schemastoreurl)|true|none|The url of your store|
|userRole|[storeUserRole](#schemastoreuserrole)|true|none|Indicates the role can have a user on a store.<br>* Owner: Indicates that you are the owner of this store<br>* User: Indicates that you are a simple user on this store<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|status|Active|
|status|SystemBlocked|
|status|UserBlocked|
|userRole|Owner|
|userRole|User|

```json
}
```

The subscription definition

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|consumerHealthStatus|[consumptionAvailabilityStatus](#schemaconsumptionavailabilitystatus)|false|none|The subscription consumption status|
|consumerLastRequestSentUri|[httpUrl](#schemahttpurl)|false|none|The URL <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/URL">https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/URL</a>|
|consumerUnvailableSinceUtcDate|string(date-time)|false|none|This date indicates since when the subscription consumer is unavailable|
|id|[subscriptionId](#schemasubscriptionid)|true|none|The identifier of the subscription to the orders for a merchant|
|lastErrorMessage|[errorResponseMessage](#schemaerrorresponsemessage)|false|none|none|
|lastOrderPushedModificationUtcDate|string(date-time)|false|none|This modification date correspond to the last order pushed by your subscription consumer|
|lastRetryUtcDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The last date we retry to send orders|
|lastSuccessfulOrderPushedUtcDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The date of the last pushed order successfully received by your subscription consumer|
|maxRetryCount|integer|false|none|The maximum BeezUP will retry to push orders. When we the retry count will reach maximum retry count, the subscription will be deactivated.|
|merchantApplicationName|[subscriptionMerchantApplicationName](#schemasubscriptionmerchantapplicationname)|true|none|The name of your application|
|merchantApplicationVersion|[subscriptionMerchantApplicationVersion](#schemasubscriptionmerchantapplicationversion)|true|none|The version of your application|
|merchantEmailAlert|[email](#schemaemail)|false|none|The email|
|name|[subscriptionName](#schemasubscriptionname)|true|none|The subscription name you want to use|
|nextScheduledRetryUtcDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The next scheduled  date we retry to send orders|
|recoverBeginPeriodOrderLastModificationUtcDate|string(date-time)|false|none|Recover existing orders using the begin period order last modification date. If not set then you will receive new/updated orders in real-time.|
|recoverEndPeriodOrderLastModificationUtcDate|string(date-time)|false|none|Recover existing orders using the begin and the end period order last modification date.<br>Otherwise, you will receive new/updated orders in real-time.<br>|
|retryCount|integer|false|none|The retry count. When we the retry count will reach maximum retry count, the subscription will be deactivated.|
|status|[subscriptionStatus](#schemasubscriptionstatus)|true|none|The status of your subscription|
|targetUrl|[httpUrl](#schemahttpurl)|true|none|The URL <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/URL">https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/URL</a>|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|consumerHealthStatus|[consumptionAvailabilityStatus](#schemaconsumptionavailabilitystatus)|false|none|The subscription consumption status|
|consumerLastRequestSentUri|[httpUrl](#schemahttpurl)|false|none|The URL <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/URL">https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/URL</a>|
|consumerUnvailableSinceUtcDate|string(date-time)|false|none|This date indicates since when the subscription consumer is unavailable|
|id|[subscriptionId](#schemasubscriptionid)|true|none|The identifier of the subscription to the orders for a merchant|
|lastErrorMessage|[errorResponseMessage](#schemaerrorresponsemessage)|false|none|none|
|lastOrderPushedModificationUtcDate|string(date-time)|false|none|This modification date correspond to the last order pushed by your subscription consumer|
|lastRetryUtcDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The last date we retry to send orders|
|lastSuccessfulOrderPushedUtcDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The date of the last pushed order successfully received by your subscription consumer|
|maxRetryCount|integer|false|none|The maximum BeezUP will retry to push orders. When we the retry count will reach maximum retry count, the subscription will be deactivated.|
|merchantApplicationName|[subscriptionMerchantApplicationName](#schemasubscriptionmerchantapplicationname)|true|none|The name of your application|
|merchantApplicationVersion|[subscriptionMerchantApplicationVersion](#schemasubscriptionmerchantapplicationversion)|true|none|The version of your application|
|merchantEmailAlert|[email](#schemaemail)|false|none|The email|
|name|[subscriptionName](#schemasubscriptionname)|true|none|The subscription name you want to use|
|nextScheduledRetryUtcDate|string(date-time)|false|none|The next scheduled  date we retry to send orders|
|recoverBeginPeriodOrderLastModificationUtcDate|string(date-time)|false|none|Recover existing orders using the begin period order last modification date. If not set then you will receive new/updated orders in real-time.|
|recoverEndPeriodOrderLastModificationUtcDate|string(date-time)|false|none|Recover existing orders using the begin and the end period order last modification date.<br>Otherwise, you will receive new/updated orders in real-time.<br>|
|retryCount|integer|false|none|The retry count. When we the retry count will reach maximum retry count, the subscription will be deactivated.|
|status|[subscriptionStatus](#schemasubscriptionstatus)|true|none|The status of your subscription|
|targetUrl|[httpUrl](#schemahttpurl)|true|none|The URL <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/URL">https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/URL</a>|
|links|[subscriptionLinks](#schemasubscriptionlinks)|false|none|none|

```json
  "productActive": "true",
  "productId": "6d469a54-8426-4855-abc2-9e062e2056b9",
  "productImageUrl": "http://cdn3.sarenza.net/static/_img/productsV4/0000010744/MD_0000010744_29411_09.jpg?201308142051",
  "productSku": "something",
  "productTitle": "Something great",
  "quantity": "1.00",
  "unitPrice": "101.42"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|margin|string|false|none|The product's margin for the external order. This property is voluntarily a string because the value could be an invalid one|
|productActive|boolean|false|none|We tried to get the catalog product if it's still active based on the product SKU. This property can be null, if we cannot found the product. This is possible if the product is not referenced in the imported catalog.|
|productId|string(guid)|false|none|We tried to get the catalog product identifier based on the product SKU. This property can be null, if we cannot found the product. This is possible if the product is not referenced in the imported catalog.|
|productImageUrl|string(uri)|false|none|We tried to get the catalog product image Url based on the product SKU. This property can be null, if we cannot found the product. This is possible if the product is not referenced in the imported catalog.|
|productSku|string|true|none|The product sku received for the external order|
|productTitle|string|false|none|We tried to get the catalog product title based on the product SKU. This property can be null, if we cannot found the product. This is possible if the product is not referenced in the imported catalog.|
|quantity|string|false|none|The quantity of this product for the external order. This property is voluntarily a string because the value could be an invalid one|
|unitPrice|string|false|none|The product's unit price for the external order. This property is voluntarily a string because the value could be an invalid one.|
